isolated_environ.pop(key, None)\n    env_file = tmp_path / \".env\"\n    env_file.write_text(\n        \"# a comment\\n\\nA_KEY = spaced value \\nB_KEY=\\\"quoted value\\\"\\nEMPTY_KEY=\\nnot a    uv run cms deploy     # push site/ to the gh-pages branch (Pages serves it)\r\n\"\"\"\r\nfrom __future__ import annotations\r\n\r\nimport argparse\r\nimport subprocess\r\nimport sys\r\n\r\nfrom app import content as content_module\r\nfrom app import settings\r\nfrom app.publish import render_site\r\n\r\n\r\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\r\n    parser = serve.add_argument(\"--port\", type=int, default=8000)\r\n    serve.add_argument(\"--reload\", action=\"store_true\", default=True)\r\n    sub.add_parser(\"publish\", help=\"publish Scheduled items   if args.command == \"publish\":\r\n        # A Scheduled item whose time (UTC) has passed becomes Published first,\r\n        # so only Published content reaches site/.\r\n        for item in One test asks every admin-only route, read from the app's router, whether the editor and an anonymous visitor are kept out. It extends MP2 rubric item D3.\n- **Prerequisites.** Part 0 complete. MP2's login and roles; `client_as` in `tests/conftest.py`. Do it after your features, so their admin-only routes are covered.\n- **Roles.** No new routes. The test covers every admin-only route, including those your features' Roles lines name.\n\n**Steps.**\n1. `echo S1 > .claude/state/phase`, then `/clear` and the prompt below.\n2. `uv run pytest -q tests/test_access_matrix.py`. **Expected:** `passed`.\n3. Check it yourself: add a throwaway admin-only route, marked the way your other admin routes are, and run the test again. It must cover the new route with no edit to the test. Delete the throwaway route.\n4. Commit with a message that starts `S1:` and push.\n\n**Prompt.**\n```text\n/tdd Write tests/test_access_matrix.py. Build the app with create_app() and collect every admin-only route from app.routes, using a marker in code (for example the admin-only dependency), not a hand-written list. For each route and its method, assert client_as(\"editor\") gets 403 or a redirect, and an anonymous client is redirected to login. Fill path parameters with the id of a seeded item. Do not change existing tests.\n```\n**Acceptance checklist.**\n| # | Step | Checked by | Pts |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 1 | `tests/test_access_matrix.py` exists and passes | test | 1 |\n| 2 | Its route list is built from the app's router (`create_app().routes`) through a marker in code, such as the admin-only dependency, not typed by hand | read | 1 |\n| 3 | A new admin-only route, marked the same way, is tested without editing the test (the judge adds one in a scratch copy) | test | 1 |\n| 4 | Every admin-only route, feature routes included, is in the generated list | read, test | 1 |\n| 5 | For each route, the editor gets 403 or a redirect | test | 1 |\n| 6 | For each route, an anonymous client is redirected to login | test | 1 |\n\n- **Out of scope.** Testing editor routes, rate limits, CSRF.\n- **Deliverables.** `tests/test_access_matrix.py`; your report row.\n- **Report row.** `| S1 | tests/test_access_matrix.py |`\n- **Scoring.** One point per row as listed. Total 6. Rows 2 and 3 together are the \"generated from the router\" tier.\n\n**If it goes wrong.**\n| Symptom | Cause | Fix |\n|---|---|---|\n| The test finds no routes | admin routes carry no marker the test can see | mark them all the same way, for example one shared dependency |\n| A route returns 422, not 403 | the path parameter is not a real id | fill it with a seeded item's id |\n#### S2 Login hardening (8 pts, about 40–55 min)\n====\n#### F7 Plugin or hook system (9 pts, about 45–60 min)\n- **Goal.** New behaviour arrives without editing the publisher. A small registry offers two hooks; plugins are Python files in `app/plugins/`, switched on and off on an admin Settings page. You ship one plugin: reading time.\n- **Prerequisites.** MP2 done and Part 0 complete. F7 and F8 share one admin Settings page (`/admin/settings`, stored in a `settings` table). Whichever of the two you build first builds the page; the other adds a field to it.\n- **Roles.** The Settings page: admin only.\n\n**Steps.**\n1. Create the issue (runbook 1), title `MP2plus F7: Plugin or hook system`; then `echo T<issue#> > .claude/state/phase`.\n2. `/clear`, then the prompt below with your issue number. Then `rm cms.db && uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py`, then walk the acceptance checklist yourself; fix what fails.\n3. `/code-review`, then the close-out message (runbook 5). `gh issue view <issue#>` shows CLOSED, with your comment above the close.\n4. Save `docs/screenshots/mp2plus-plugins-1280.png` and `mp2plus-plugins-390.png`: the Settings page with the plugin switch. Closes #22.\n---\n5cf2937 Rajan Thakur <rajansthakr@gmail.com>\nT21: Completed the F1 media uploads and resolved issues with alt text visibility, naming the refusal message, and also the partial file issue. Closes #21\n---\nc755c3f Rajan Thakur <rajansthakr@gmail.com>\nT21: Media uploads with alt text\n\nEditors and Admins upload PNG and JPEG images of 2 MB or less to a new\nMedia library (admin nav: Media). Every upload needs Alt text. Each item\nshows a copyable snippet, ![alt](media/<file>), to paste into a Post.\n\n- Uploads are written to media/ (git-ignored, like cms.db) under a\n  cleaned name, created exclusively (\"xb\") so two uploads never share a\n  file. A new `media` table (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS) keeps the Alt\n  text, so an existing cms.db needs no re-seed.\n- The type is checked by extension and by the file's first bytes, so a\n  .html renamed .png is refused. Refusals return 400 with a message; a\n  POST without its CSRF token returns 403.\n- Alt text is refused when Markdown would change it in a post. The rule\n  is a round trip through render_markdown, because markdown-it drops\n  even backslash-escaped characters from an image's alt.\n- cms publish copies media/ into site/media/. render_markdown makes a\n  media/ URL relative to the file it lands in (../media/x.png from a\n  Post). The editor's previews do the same for their admin page; the\n  live preview sends its page's to_root, and the server accepts only\n  \"../\" steps.\n- The admin serves /media/ to logged-in users only, and only image\n  files directly inside media/.\n\ntests/test_media.py has 57 tests named test_step<k>_..., 4 of them in\nChromium. tests/conftest.py gains two lines (an isolated media/ per\ntest); no existing assertion changed. 343 tests pass;\ncheck_submission.py --stage 2 is 22/22. Screenshots:\ndocs/screenshots/mp2plus-media-{1280,390}.png.\n\nCloses #21\n\nCo-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>\n---\n8:.admin main { max-width: 64rem; }\n9:/* The public site reads as one narrow column: header and footer line up with it. */\n10:.site .topbar__inner, .site .site-footer { max-width: 46rem; }\n11:.back-link { display: inline-block; margin-top: 1.25rem; }\n12:.site-footer { max-width: 64rem; margin: 3rem auto 2rem; padding: 0 1rem; text-align: center; }\n14:/* Navigation: the public site's Page links and the admin sections. */\n15:.site-nav, .admin-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem; }\n16:.site-nav a, .admin-nav a {\n23:.site-nav a:hover, .admin-nav a:hover { background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text); }\n24:.admin-nav a[aria-current=\"page\"] { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); }\n25:.admin-user { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; margin-left: auto; }\n26:.admin-nav__who { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.92rem; }\n29:/* ---- Surfaces --------------------------------------------------------- */\n30:/* Every raised surface (cards, lists, filters, stat tiles, feed cards). */\n31:.card, .content-list, .content-filters, .stat, .post-card {\n37:.card {\n40:.page-head {\n48:.page-head h1 { margin: 0; }\n49:.lede { color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.05rem; margin-top: -0.25rem; }\n50:.empty {\n58:/* ---- Buttons ------------------------------------------------------------ */\n78:.button--secondary {\n83:.button--secondary:hover {\n87:.button--danger {\n92:.button--danger:hover {\n97:.button--ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--muted); border-color: var(--border); }\n98:.button--ghost:hover { background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text); }\n99:.button--small { padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.88rem; }\n101:/* ---- Forms --------------------------------------------------------------- */\n117:.content-form label, form.login-form label {\n123:.content-form label input, .content-form label select, .content-form label textarea {\n129:.form-actions { display: flex; Closes #21\n---\nc755c3f Rajan Thakur <rajansthakr@gmail.com>\nT21: Media uploads with alt text\n\nEditors and Admins upload PNG and JPEG images of 2 MB or less to a new\nMedia library (admin nav: Media). Every upload needs Alt text. Each item\nshows a copyable snippet, ![alt](media/<file>), to paste into a Post.\n\n- Uploads are written to media/ (git-ignored, like cms.db) under a\n  cleaned name, created exclusively (\"xb\") so two uploads never share a\n  file. A new `media` table (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS) keeps the Alt\n  text, so an existing cms.db needs no re-seed.\n- The type is checked by extension and by the file's first bytes, so a\n  .html renamed .png is refused. Refusals return 400 with a message; a\n  POST without its CSRF token returns 403.\n- Alt text is refused when Markdown would change it in a post. The rule\n  is a round trip through render_markdown, because markdown-it drops\n  even backslash-escaped characters from an image's alt.\n- cms publish copies media/ into site/media/. render_markdown makes a\n  media/ URL relative to the file it lands in (../media/x.png from a\n  Post). The editor's previews do the same for their admin page; the\n  live preview sends its page's to_root, and the server accepts only\n  \"../\" steps.\n- The admin serves /media/ to logged-in users only, and only image\n  files directly inside media/.\n\ntests/test_media.py has 57 tests named test_step<k>_..., 4 of them in\nChromium. tests/conftest.py gains two lines (an isolated media/ per\ntest); no existing assertion changed. 343 tests pass;\ncheck_submission.py --stage 2 is 22/22. {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"0008ac86-4a00-4c89-8a62-5971452a5ff3","hash":"c1c37765adb62ada10f263cf6ade08b20adf74dffea7e711d69aee1d54c60dda","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_013uSgrXBVzSe9EYQQRUTE8g","content":"Launching skill: mattpocock-skills:tdd"},{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: C:\\Users\\rajan\\.claude\\plugins\\cache\\claude-plugins-official\\mattpocock-skills\\1.3.1\\skills\\engineering\\tdd\n\n# Test-Driven Development\r\n\r\nTDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\r\n\r\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `GLOSSARY.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\r\n\r\n## What a good test is\r\n\r\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\r\n\r\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\r\n\r\n## Seams: where tests go\r\n\r\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\r\n\r\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\r\n\r\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\" Give each proposed seam a one-line note on what it catches and what it misses.\r\n\r\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\r\n\r\n## Anti-patterns\r\n\r\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\r\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\r\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\r\n\r\n## Rules of the loop\r\n\r\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\r\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\r\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\r\n\n\nARGUMENTS: F8 #23 switchable theme. Agreed seams: (1) HTTP via client_as for /admin/settings, admin-only guard, CSRF replay (step 6); (2) cli.main([\"publish\"]) into tmp settings.SITE for steps 3-4; (3) restart for step 2: fresh create_app() + client reads stored theme; (4) Playwright 390px home + one post in both themes (step 5), skips without Chromium. Tests in tests/test_theme.py named test_step<k>_<what>."}]}}

{"parentUuid":"329e9f04-0145-4c89-82cb-567055e0eef0","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"7c93a0cb-6af1-4200-add8-f3f8ea098e20","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: C:\\Users\\rajan\\.claude\\plugins\\cache\\claude-plugins-official\\mattpocock-skills\\1.3.1\\skills\\engineering\\tdd\n\n# Test-Driven Development\r\n\r\nTDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\r\n\r\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `GLOSSARY.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\r\n\r\n## What a good test is\r\n\r\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\r\n\r\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\r\n\r\n## Seams: where tests go\r\n\r\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\r\n\r\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\r\n\r\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\" Give each proposed seam a one-line note on what it catches and what it misses.\r\n\r\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\r\n\r\n## Anti-patterns\r\n\r\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\r\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\r\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\r\n\r\n## Rules of the loop\r\n\r\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\r\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\r\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\r\n\n\nARGUMENTS: F8 #23 switchable theme. Agreed seams: (1) HTTP via client_as for /admin/settings, admin-only guard, CSRF replay (step 6); (2) cli.main([\"publish\"]) into tmp settings.SITE for steps 3-4; (3) restart for step 2: fresh create_app() + client reads stored theme; (4) Playwright 390px home + one post in both themes (step 5), skips without Chromium. }\n.lede { color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.05rem; margin-top: -0.25rem; }\n.empty {\n  text-align: center;\n  color: var(--muted);\n  padding: 2rem 1rem;\n  border: 1px dashed var(--border);\n  border-radius: var(--radius);\n}\n\n/* ---- Buttons ------------------------------------------------------------ */\nbutton, .button {\n  display: inline-flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  justify-content: center;\n  gap: 0.35rem;\n  font: inherit;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  font-size: 0.95rem;\n  line-height: 1.2;\n  padding: 0.55rem 1rem;\n  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);\n  border: 1px solid transparent;\n  background: var(--accent);\n  color: var(--on-accent);\n  text-decoration: none;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  transition: background-color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s;\n}\nbutton:hover, .button:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); color: var(--on-accent); }\n.button--secondary {\n  background: var(--surface);\n  border-color: var(--border);\n  color: var(--text);\n}\n.button--secondary:hover {\n  background: var(--surface-muted);\n  color: var(--text);\n}\n.button--danger {\n  background: transparent;\n  border-color: var(--border);\n  color: var(--danger);\n}\n.button--danger:hover {\n  background: var(--danger-soft);\n  border-color: var(--danger);\n  color: var(--danger);\n}\n.button--ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--muted); border-color: var(--border); }\n.button--ghost:hover { background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text); }\n.button--small { padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.88rem; }\n\n/* ---- Forms --------------------------------------------------------------- */\ninput, select, textarea {\n  font: inherit;\n  color: var(--text);\n  background: var(--surface);\n  border: 1px solid var(--control-border);\n  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);\n  padding: 0.6rem 0.75rem;\n  max-width: 100%;\n}\ninput:focus-visible, select:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible {\n  outline-offset: 0;\n  border-color: var(--accent);\n}\ntextarea { width: 100%; html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n  <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n  <title>{% block title %}{{ title }}{% endblock %}</title>\n  <link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"{% block css_href %}{{ css_path | default('style.css') }}{% endblock %}\">\n</head>\n<body class=\"{% block body_class %}site{% endblock %}\">\n  <header class=\"topbar\">\n    <div class=\"topbar__inner\">\n      {% block brand %}<a class=\"brand\" href=\"{{ home_path | default('index.html') }}\"><span class=\"brand__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">✦</span>{{ site_title | default(title) }}</a>{% endblock %}\n      {% block topnav %}\n        {% if nav_items %}\n          <nav class=\"site-nav\" aria-label=\"Pages\">\n            {% for item in nav_items %}<a href=\"{{ item.href }}\">{{ item.title }}</a>{% endfor %}\n          </nav>\n        {% endif %}\n      {% endblock %}\n    </div>\n  </header>\n  <main>{% block content %}{% endblock %}</main>\n  <footer class=\"site-footer\"><small>IPHS 400 Mini-Project #2</small></footer>\n</body>\n</html>\n{% extends \"admin/base.html\" %}\r\n{% block admin_content %}\r\n  <div class=\"page-head\">\r\n    <h1>Users</h1>\r\n    <a class=\"button\" href=\"{{ to_root }}admin/users/new\">New user</a>\r\n  </div>\r\n  {% if saved == \"created\" %}<p class=\"success\">User created.</p>{% endif %}\r\n  {% if saved == \"role-changed\" %}<p class=\"success\">Role updated.</p>{% endif %}\r\n  {% if saved == \"deactivated\" %}<p class=\"success\">User deactivated.</p>{% endif %}\r\n  {% if error %}<p class=\"error\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\r\n  <ul class=\"content-list\">\r\n    {% for u in users %}\r\n      <li class=\"content-list__item\">\r\n        <div class=\"content-list__main\">\r\n          <span class=\"content-list__title\">{{ u[\"email\"] }}</span>\r\n          <span class=\"content-list__meta\">\r\n            <span class=\"badge badge--{{ u['role'] }}\">{{ u[\"role\"] }}</span>\r\n            {% if not u[\"active\"] %}<span class=\"badge\">deactivated</span>{% endif %}\r\n          </span>\r\n        </div>\r\n        {% if u[\"active\"] %}\r\n          <div class=\"content-list__actions\">\r\n            <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ to_root }}admin/users/{{ u['id'] }}/role\" class=\"content-list__publish\">\r\n              <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token }}\">\r\n              <select name=\"role\" aria-label=\"Role for {{ u['email'] }}\">\r\n                <option value=\"editor\" {% if u[\"role\"] == \"editor\" %}selected{% endif %}>editor</option>\r\n                <option value=\"admin\" {% if u[\"role\"] == \"admin\" %}selected{% endif %}>admin</option>\r\n              </select>\r\n              <button type=\"submit\" class=\"button--secondary button--small\">Change role</button>\r\n            </form>\r\n            <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ to_root }}admin/users/{{ u['id'] }}/deactivate\" class=\"content-list__delete\">\r\n              <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token }}\">\r\n              <button type=\"submit\" class=\"button--danger button--small\">Deactivate</button>\r\n            </form>\r\n          </div>\r\n        {% endif %}\r\n      </li>\r\n    {% endfor %}\r\n  </ul>\r\n{% endblock %}\r\n{% extends \"admin/base.html\" %}\n{% block admin_content %}\n  <div class=\"page-head\">\n    <h1>Media</h1>\n  </div>\n  {% if saved == \"uploaded\" %}<p class=\"success\">Image uploaded. Copy its Markdown into a post.</p>{% endif %}\n  {% if error %}<p class=\"error\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ to_root }}admin/media/upload\" enctype=\"multipart/form-data\"\n        class=\"content-form card media-upload\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token }}\">\n    <label>Image (PNG or JPEG, 2 MB or less)\n      <input type=\"file\" name=\"image\" accept=\".png,.jpg,.jpeg,image/png,image/jpeg\" required>\n    </label>\n    <label>Alt text\n      <input type=\"text\" name=\"alt_text\" value=\"{{ form_alt }}\" aria-describedby=\"alt-hint\">\n    </label>\n    <p id=\"alt-hint\" class=\"media-upload__hint\">Describe the image for someone who can't see it,\n      e.g. \"Club members at the hackathon\". A screen reader reads this aloud.</p>\n    <div class=\"form-actions\">\n      <button type=\"submit\">Upload</button>\n    </div>\n  </form>\n  {% if items %}\n    <ul class=\"content-list media-list\">\n      {% for item in items %}\n        <li class=\"content-list__item media-item\">\n          <img class=\"media-item__image\" src=\"{{ to_root }}media/{{ item['filename'] }}\" alt=\"{{ item['alt_text'] }}\">\n          <div class=\"content-list__main\">\n            <span class=\"content-list__title\">{{ item[\"alt_text\"] }}</span>\n            <span class=\"content-list__meta\">{{ item[\"filename\"] }} · {{ item[\"uploaded_by_email\"] }} · {{ item[\"uploaded_at\"] | utc_time }}</span>\n            <div class=\"media-item__copy\">\n              <input type=\"text\" class=\"media-item__snippet\" readonly value=\"{{ item['snippet'] }}\"\n                     aria-label=\"Markdown for a post: {{ item['alt_text'] }}\">\n              <button type=\"button\" class=\"button--secondary button--small\" data-copy>Copy</button>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </li>\n      {% endfor %}\n    </ul>\n  {% else %}\n    <p class=\"empty\">No images yet. Upload the first one above.</p>\n  {% endif %}\n  <script>\n    // Copy a snippet with one click. Each test is named after the\nacceptance step it checks:\n\n  1. Two themes exist, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/\n  2. The admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice survives a\n     server restart\n  3. `uv run cms publish` writes the selected theme's CSS as site/style.css,\n     so every page's relative stylesheet link still works\n  4. Switching back and publishing again restores the first theme's CSS\n  5. Both themes show no horizontal overflow at 390 px on the home page and\n     one post\n  6. The Settings form carries a CSRF token; its POST replayed without the\n     token is refused\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nTHEMES_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / \"app\" / \"themes\"\n\n\n# -- Step 1: two themes, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/ --\n\ndef test_step1_two_themes_each_one_css_file_in_its_own_folder():\n    folders = sorted(path for path in THEMES_DIR.iterdir() if path.is_dir())\n\n    assert [folder.name for folder in folders] == [\"chapter\", \"default\"]\n    for folder in folders:\n        assert [file.name for file in folder.iterdir()] == [\"style.css\"], folder\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":10230,"cache_read_input_tokens":132736,"output_tokens":895,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":67},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":10230,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":895,"cache_read_input_tokens":132736,"cache_creation_input_tokens":10230,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":10230},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01UKFnQvUjvLFp5ZcAHGYyfo":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\tests\\test_theme.py","content":"\"\"\"MP2plus F8: Switchable theme (issue #23). {"parentUuid":"66fee4fa-6ff7-4325-b1ad-0d124cd8d6e4","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgEuE7Nnye2JgsGcfVC5b","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_013ZFArZNKsdKHWGRiReB21V","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\theme.py","content":"\"\"\"The site's Theme (see CONTEXT.md): which stylesheet, of the ones in\napp/themes/<name>/style.css, the admin console and the Static export use.\n\nAn Admin picks it on the Settings page. The choice is a row in the\ndatabase's `settings` table and is read again on every use, so a switch\nreaches the next page load and the next `cms publish` with no restart.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import db as db_module\n\nTHEMES_DIR = Path(__file__).with_name(\"themes\")\nDEFAULT_THEME = \"default\"\nSETTING_KEY = \"theme\"\n\n# A stylesheet's description is the first line of its opening /* comment */.\nDESCRIPTION_RE = re.compile(r\"\\s*/\\*\\s*(.*?)\\s*(?:\\*/|\\n)\")\n\n\nclass UnknownTheme(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A theme name with no app/themes/<name>/style.css.\"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Theme:\n    name: str\n    description: str\n\n\ndef _css_path(name: str) -> Path:\n    return THEMES_DIR / name / \"style.css\"\n\n\ndef names() -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Every theme's name, the default first, then A to Z.\"\"\"\n    found = [path.parent.name for path in THEMES_DIR.glob(\"*/style.css\")]\n    return sorted(found, key=lambda name: (name != DEFAULT_THEME, name))\n\n\ndef available() -> list[Theme]:\n    \"\"\"Every theme, in names() order, for the Settings page.\"\"\"\n    themes = []\n    for name in names():\n        match = DESCRIPTION_RE.match(css(name))\n        themes.append(Theme(name, match.group(1) if match else \"\"))\n    return themes\n\n\ndef selected() -> str:\n    \"\"\"The stored theme, or the default when none is stored yet or the\n    stored one's folder has since been removed.\"\"\"\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = ?\",\n                           (SETTING_KEY,)).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n    return row[\"value\"] if row and row[\"value\"] in names() else DEFAULT_THEME\n\n\ndef select(name: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Store `name` as the site's theme. Raises UnknownTheme if there is no\n    such theme, so only a real folder's name is ever stored.\"\"\"\n    if name not in names():\n        raise UnknownTheme(name)\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?) \"\n            \"ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value\",\n            (SETTING_KEY, name),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef css(name: str | None = None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The stylesheet of theme `name`, or of the selected theme, read fresh\n    from its file.\"\"\"\n    return _css_path(name or selected()).read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":778,"cache_read_input_tokens":144189,"output_tokens":2190,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":1021},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":778,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2190,"cache_read_input_tokens":144189,"cache_creation_input_tokens":778,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":778},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_013ZFArZNKsdKHWGRiReB21V":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\theme.py","content":"\"\"\"The site's Theme (see CONTEXT.md): which stylesheet, of the ones in\napp/themes/<name>/style.css, the admin console and the Static export use.\n\nAn Admin picks it on the Settings page. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"56ae31d0-ca51-4c88-b784-1a20b755ce94","timestamp":"2026-10-21T06:23:23.310Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\theme.py","oldString":"def _css_path(name: str) -> Path:\n    return THEMES_DIR / name / \"style.css\"\n\n\ndef names() -> list[str]:","newString":"def names() -> list[str]:","originalFile":"\"\"\"The site's Theme (see CONTEXT.md): which stylesheet, of the ones in\napp/themes/<name>/style.css, the admin console and the Static export use.\n\nAn Admin picks it on the Settings page. The choice is a row in the\ndatabase's `settings` table and is read again on every use, so a switch\nreaches the next page load and the next `cms publish` with no restart.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import db as db_module\n\nTHEMES_DIR = Path(__file__).with_name(\"themes\")\nDEFAULT_THEME = \"default\"\nSETTING_KEY = \"theme\"\n\n# A stylesheet's description is the first line of its opening /* comment */.\nDESCRIPTION_RE = re.compile(r\"\\s*/\\*\\s*(.*?)\\s*(?:\\*/|\\n)\")\n\n\nclass UnknownTheme(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A theme name with no app/themes/<name>/style.css.\"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Theme:\n    name: str\n    description: str\n\n\ndef _css_path(name: str) -> Path:\n    return THEMES_DIR / name / \"style.css\"\n\n\ndef names() -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Every theme's name, the default first, then A to Z.\"\"\"\n    found = [path.parent.name for path in THEMES_DIR.glob(\"*/style.css\")]\n    return sorted(found, key=lambda name: (name != DEFAULT_THEME, name))\n\n\ndef available() -> list[Theme]:\n    \"\"\"Every theme, in names() order, for the Settings page.\"\"\"\n    themes = []\n    for name in names():\n        match = DESCRIPTION_RE.match(css(name))\n        themes.append(Theme(name, match.group(1) if match else \"\"))\n    return themes\n\n\ndef selected() -> str:\n    \"\"\"The stored theme, or the default when none is stored yet or the\n    stored one's folder has since been removed.\"\"\"\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = ?\",\n                           (SETTING_KEY,)).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n    return row[\"value\"] if row and row[\"value\"] in names() else DEFAULT_THEME\n\n\ndef select(name: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Store `name` as the site's theme. Raises UnknownTheme if there is no\n    such theme, so only a real folder's name is ever stored.\"\"\"\n    if name not in names():\n        raise UnknownTheme(name)\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?) \"\n            \"ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value\",\n            (SETTING_KEY, name),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef css(name: str | None = None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The stylesheet of theme `name`, or of the selected theme, read fresh\n    from its file.\"\"\"\n    return _css_path(name or selected()).read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":31,"oldLines":10,"newStart":31,"newLines":6,"lines":["     description: str"," "," ","-def _css_path(name: str) -> Path:","-    return THEMES_DIR / name / \"style.css\"","-","-"," def names() -> list[str]:","     \"\"\"Every theme's name, the default first, then A to Z.\"\"\"","     found = [path.parent.name for path in THEMES_DIR.glob(\"*/style.css\")]"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"29e5df96-5230-49f0-9933-507d5c1b1ae4","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"46a8d74b-d860-4909-a43f-d4dbcfcc3476","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"0008ac86-4a00-4c89-8a62-5971452a5ff3","version":"2.1.305","gitBranch":"mp2plus-f8"}

As you build content types, extend\nrender_site() to write one file per published item. Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n     That includes links written in a body: render_markdown(..., to_root=...)\n     rewrites \"/contact-us.html\" and \"media/logo.png\" for the file it lands in.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.mdrender import render_markdown, render_text\n\n# One stylesheet for the public site and the admin console (served at /style.css).\nCSS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"style.css\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n# search.html's one script, which searches site/search-index.json.\nSEARCH_JS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"search.js\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n# The most characters of a body that search.html shows under a result's title.\nEXCERPT_LENGTH = 160\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef nav_items(prefix: str = \"\") -> list[dict[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Published Pages, as relative (title, href) links for the public\n    site's nav. `prefix` relocates the link for a page nested one\n    directory deep (e.g. \"../\" from site/posts/*.html) — a draft Page\n    never appears here.\"\"\"\n    return [{\"title\": page[\"title\"], \"href\": f\"{prefix}{page['slug']}.html\"}\n            for page in _exportable_pages()]\n\n\ndef _exportable_pages() -> list:\n    # The editor already refuses reserved slugs; this also covers rows saved\n    # before that check existed, so a Page can never overwrite site/index.html.\n    return [page for page in content_module.list_published(\"page\")\n            if not content_module.reserved_slug_reason(\"page\", page[\"slug\"])]\n\n\ndef _date(item) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The calendar day an item was created, e.g. \"2026-10-07\".\"\"\"\n    return item[\"created_at\"][:10]\n\n\ndef home_html() -> str:\n    \"\"\"The home page (feed of published Posts), as written to site/index.html.\"\"\"\n    posts = content_module.list_published(\"post\")\n    return environment().get_template(\"public/home.html\").render(\n        title=settings.SITE_TITLE, items=[\n            {\"title\": post[\"title\"], \"href\": f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\",\n             \"date\": _date(post)} for post in posts\n        ],\n        css_path=\"style.css\", home_path=\"index.html\", nav_items=nav_items(),\n    )\n\n\ndef search_html() -> str:\n    \"\"\"The search page, as written to site/search.html; its script is\n    site/search.js.\"\"\"\n    return environment().get_template(\"public/search.html\").render(\n        title=\"Search\", site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n        css_path=\"style.css\", home_path=\"index.html\", nav_items=nav_items(),\n    )\n\n\ndef search_index_json() -> str:\n    \"\"\"site/search-index.json: the title, URL and a plain-text excerpt of\n    every published Post and Page, for search.html's script to search. Each\n    URL is relative to the site root, where search.html is.\"\"\"\n    items = [(post, f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\")\n             for post in content_module.list_published(\"post\")]\n    items += [(page, f\"{page['slug']}.html\") for page in _exportable_pages()]\n    return json.dumps([\n        {\"title\": item[\"title\"], \"url\": url, \"excerpt\": _excerpt(item[\"body_md\"])}\n        for item, url in items\n    ], ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)\n\n\ndef _excerpt(body_md: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The start of a body as plain text, EXCERPT_LENGTH characters or fewer\n    with the \"…\" that ends it when anything was cut. The cut falls at a word\n    break, unless the text has none to fall at.\"\"\"\n    text = render_text(body_md)\n    if len(text) <= EXCERPT_LENGTH:\n        return text\n    head = text[:EXCERPT_LENGTH]\n    cut = head.rsplit(\" \", 1)[0] if \" \" in head else head[:-1]\n    return (cut.rstrip(\" .,;:\") or cut) + \"…\"\n\n\ndef post_html(post) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A published Post, as written to site/posts/<slug>.html — one directory\n    deep, so every shared link climbs a level.\"\"\"\n    return _detail_html(\"public/post.html\", \"post\", post, prefix=\"../\")\n\n\ndef page_html(page) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A published Page, as written to site/<slug>.html.\"\"\"\n    return _detail_html(\"public/page.html\", \"page\", page, prefix=\"\")\n\n\ndef _detail_html(template_name: str, item_key: str, item, *, prefix: str) -> str:\n    return environment().get_template(template_name).render(\n        title=item[\"title\"], site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n        **{item_key: item}, date=_date(item),\n        body_html=render_markdown(item[\"body_md\"], to_root=prefix),\n        css_path=f\"{prefix}style.css\", home_path=f\"{prefix}index.html\",\n        nav_items=nav_items(prefix=prefix),\n    )\n\n\ndef _write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:\n    # Explicit UTF-8: the pages declare <meta charset=\"utf-8\">, and the\n    # platform default (cp1252 on Windows) can't encode an emoji at all.\n    path.write_text(text, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    _write(out / \"style.css\", CSS)\n    _write(out / \"index.html\", home_html())\n    _write(out / \"search.html\", search_html())\n    _write(out / \"search.js\", SEARCH_JS)\n    _write(out / \"search-index.json\", search_index_json())\n\n    posts_dir = out / \"posts\"\n    posts_dir.mkdir()\n    for post in content_module.list_published(\"post\"):\n        _write(posts_dir / f\"{post['slug']}.html\", post_html(post))\n    for page in _exportable_pages():\n        _write(out / f\"{page['slug']}.html\", page_html(page))\n\n    # Every file in media/ is meant to be public; Posts show them through\n    # their Media library snippets.\n    if settings.MEDIA.is_dir():\n        shutil.copytree(settings.MEDIA, out / \"media\")\n\n    return out\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":19,"oldLines":10,"newStart":19,"newLines":9,"lines":[" "," from app import content as content_module"," from app import settings","+from app import theme as theme_module"," from app.mdrender import render_markdown, render_text"," ","-# One stylesheet for the public site and the admin console (served at /style.css).","-CSS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"style.css\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")"," # Every file in media/ is meant to be public; Posts show them through\n    # their Media library snippets.\n    if settings.MEDIA.is_dir():\n        shutil.copytree(settings.MEDIA, out / \"media\")\n\n    return out\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":135,"oldLines":7,"newStart":135,"newLines":7,"lines":["     if out.exists():","         shutil.rmtree(out)","     out.mkdir(parents=True)","-    _write(out / \"style.css\", CSS)","+    shutil.copyfile(theme_module.stylesheet(theme_module.DEFAULT_THEME), out / \"style.css\")","     _write(out / \"index.html\", home_html())","     _write(out / \"search.html\", search_html())","     _write(out / \"search.js\", SEARCH_JS)"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"55650fe0-a0ba-439e-8bff-46422f66e343","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"46a8d74b-d860-4909-a43f-d4dbcfcc3476","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"0008ac86-4a00-4c89-8a62-5971452a5ff3","version":"2.1.305","gitBranch":"mp2plus-f8"}

{"parentUuid":"92be03dc-71aa-4e71-8f95-546822be67e5","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgEuUXwnjKgZDKYe9jF7c","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Vu7SyeinnnG2js6YV5UVDY","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\routes\\admin_settings.py","content":"\"\"\"The admin-only Settings page (MP2plus F8, issue #23): an Admin picks the\nsite's Theme. The choice is stored in the database, so it survives a\nrestart; the admin console shows it on the next page load, and the public\nsite gets it on the next `cms publish`.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import security\nfrom app import theme as theme_module\nfrom app.guards import require_admin\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/settings\")\n\nCSRF_EXPIRED_MESSAGE = \"Your session expired — please try again.\"\nUNKNOWN_THEME_MESSAGE = \"Pick one of the themes listed.\"\n\n\ndef _require_admin_for_settings(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    return require_admin(request, detail=\"Only an Admin can change the site's settings.\")\n\n\ndef _render(request, user, *, saved=None, error=None, status_code=200):\n    csrf_token, new_cookie = security.read_or_mint_csrf(request)\n    response = templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/settings.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Settings\", \"current_user\": user, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token,\n         \"themes\": theme_module.available(), \"selected_theme\": theme_module.selected(),\n         \"saved\": saved, \"error\": error},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n    return security.set_csrf_cookie(response, new_cookie)\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef settings_page(request: Request, user=Depends(_require_admin_for_settings)):\n    return _render(request, user, saved=request.query_params.get(\"saved\"))\n\n\n@router.post(\"\")\ndef save_settings(\n    request: Request,\n    theme: str = Form(\"\"),\n    csrf_token: str = Form(\"\"),\n    user=Depends(_require_admin_for_settings),\n):\n    # Fields default to empty rather than being required, so a POST missing\n    # its token gets this page's message, not a 422.\n    if not security.verify_csrf(csrf_token, request.cookies.get(security.CSRF_COOKIE)):\n        return _render(request, user, error=CSRF_EXPIRED_MESSAGE, status_code=403)\n    try:\n        theme_module.select(theme)\n    except theme_module.UnknownTheme:\n        return _render(request, user, error=UNKNOWN_THEME_MESSAGE, status_code=400)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/settings?saved=theme\", status_code=303)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":4245,"cache_read_input_tokens":167132,"output_tokens":2714,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":87},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":4245,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2714,"cache_read_input_tokens":167132,"cache_creation_input_tokens":4245,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":4245},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01Vu7SyeinnnG2js6YV5UVDY":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\routes\\admin_settings.py","content":"\"\"\"The admin-only Settings page (MP2plus F8, issue #23): an Admin picks the\nsite's Theme. Fields default to empty rather than being required, so a POST missing\n    # its token gets this page's message, not a 422.\n    if not security.verify_csrf(csrf_token, request.cookies.get(security.CSRF_COOKIE)):\n        return _render(request, user, error=CSRF_EXPIRED_MESSAGE, status_code=403)\n    try:\n        theme_module.select(theme)\n    except theme_module.UnknownTheme:\n        return _render(request, user, error=UNKNOWN_THEME_MESSAGE, status_code=400)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/settings?saved=theme\", status_code=303)\n"}},"serverClassifierRequest":"86fe8a6d-7ece-494d-a3e8-a8b4c786ac4f","apiBlockIndex":3,"requestId":"req_011CgEuUXYzFd5us9s3VbRbW","requestRef":"0123aaeb-fcc5-410d-b3dc-d054a0c5ff5d","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:tdd","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"0c677672-aae8-45a8-8e00-a1a6725e98f4","timestamp":"2026-10-21T06:25:54.482Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"xhigh","perTurnEffort":"xhigh","session_id":"46a8d74b-d860-4909-a43f-d4dbcfcc3476","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"0008ac86-4a00-4c89-8a62-5971452a5ff3","version":"2.1.305","gitBranch":"mp2plus-f8"}

A missing row means the default.\n-- Unlike the configuration in .env (app/settings.py), these change while\n-- the CMS runs.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (\n    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    value TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\"\"\"","originalFile":"\"\"\"SQLite connection and schema. No ORM (see spec Implementation Decisions).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS content (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('post', 'page')),\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug TEXT NOT NULL,\n    body_md TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')) DEFAULT 'draft',\n    author_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    -- Set on a Draft that is Scheduled (see CONTEXT.md): the UTC time after\n    -- which the next `cms publish` makes it Published. NULL otherwise.\n    publish_at TEXT,\n    UNIQUE (kind, slug)\n);\n\n-- One row per saved version of a content item (see CONTEXT.md: Revision).\n-- `version` counts 1, 2, 3... within one item; `rolled_back_to` is set when\n-- the save was a Roll back, to the version it rolled back to.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS revisions (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    content_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES content(id),\n    version INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug TEXT NOT NULL,\n    body_md TEXT NOT NULL,\n    saved_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    saved_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    rolled_back_to INTEGER,\n    UNIQUE (content_id, version)\n);\n\n-- One row per image in the Media library (see CONTEXT.md). The file itself\n-- is media/<filename>; the row keeps what the file can't: its Alt text.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    filename TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    alt_text TEXT NOT NULL,\n    uploaded_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\n# Items saved before revisions existed get one starting revision from their\n# current state, so their pre-T15 text can still be rolled back to. The last\n# editor was never stored, so the Author stands in as who saved it. A no-op\n# once every item has a revision.\nBACKFILL_REVISIONS = \"\"\"\nINSERT INTO revisions (content_id, version, title, slug, body_md, saved_by, saved_at)\nSELECT id, 1, title, slug, body_md, author_id, updated_at FROM content\nWHERE id NOT IN (SELECT content_id FROM revisions);\n\"\"\"\n\n# Columns added to existing tables after they were first created. CREATE\n# TABLE IF NOT EXISTS never changes a table that already exists, so a database\n# made before a column existed gains it here. Maps table -> [(column, type)].\nADDED_COLUMNS = {\"content\": [(\"publish_at\", \"TEXT\")]}\n\n# Database files already brought up to date by this process.\n_schema_ready: set[str] = set()\n\n\ndef _path(db_path: Path | None) -> Path:\n    # Read lazily (settings.DATABASE_PATH) so tests can monkeypatch it per-test.\n    return db_path if db_path is not None else settings.DATABASE_PATH\n\n\ndef _open(path: Path) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(path)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    return conn\n\n\ndef connect(db_path: Path | None = None) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n    \"\"\"Open a connection to the CMS database. The first open of each file in\n    a process runs init_db, so a database made before a newer table existed\n    works without a re-seed.\"\"\"\n    path = _path(db_path)\n    if str(Path(path).resolve()) not in _schema_ready:\n        init_db(path)\n    return _open(path)\n\n\ndef _add_missing_columns(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:\n    for table, columns in ADDED_COLUMNS.items():\n        present = {row[\"name\"] for row in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info({table})\")}\n        for name, sql_type in columns:\n            if name not in present:\n                conn.execute(f\"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {name} {sql_type}\")\n\n\ndef init_db(db_path: Path | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Create any missing tables and columns, and backfill starting\n    revisions. Safe to run on a new or an existing database, any number of\n    times.\"\"\"\n    path = _path(db_path)\n    conn = _open(path)\n    try:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        _add_missing_columns(conn)\n        conn.executescript(BACKFILL_REVISIONS)\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n    _schema_ready.add(str(Path(path).resolve()))\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":57,"oldLines":6,"newStart":57,"newLines":15,"lines":["     uploaded_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),","     uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))"," );","+","+-- Choices an Admin makes on the Settings page (see CONTEXT.md), one row per","+-- setting, e.g. ('theme', 'chapter'). A missing row means the default.","+-- Unlike the configuration in .env (app/settings.py), these change while","+-- the CMS runs.","+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (","+    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,","+    value TEXT NOT NULL","+);"," \"\"\""," "," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"92be03dc-71aa-4e71-8f95-546822be67e5","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"46a8d74b-d860-4909-a43f-d4dbcfcc3476","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"0008ac86-4a00-4c89-8a62-5971452a5ff3","version":"2.1.305","gitBranch":"mp2plus-f8"}

{"parentUuid":"0c677672-aae8-45a8-8e00-a1a6725e98f4","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"7c93a0cb-6af1-4200-add8-f3f8ea098e20","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Vu7SyeinnnG2js6YV5UVDY","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\routes\\admin_settings.py (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"e3819f6b-e6a4-4a96-a07f-5e290258c750","timestamp":"2026-10-21T06:26:03.332Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\routes\\admin_settings.py","content":"\"\"\"The admin-only Settings page (MP2plus F8, issue #23): an Admin picks the\nsite's Theme. The choice is stored in the database, so it survives a\nrestart; the admin console shows it on the next page load, and the public\nsite gets it on the next `cms publish`.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import security\nfrom app import theme as theme_module\nfrom app.guards import require_admin\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/settings\")\n\nCSRF_EXPIRED_MESSAGE = \"Your session expired — please try again.\"\nUNKNOWN_THEME_MESSAGE = \"Pick one of the themes listed.\"\n\n\ndef _require_admin_for_settings(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    return require_admin(request, detail=\"Only an Admin can change the site's settings.\")\n\n\ndef _render(request, user, *, saved=None, error=None, status_code=200):\n    csrf_token, new_cookie = security.read_or_mint_csrf(request)\n    response = templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/settings.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Settings\", \"current_user\": user, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token,\n         \"themes\": theme_module.available(), \"selected_theme\": theme_module.selected(),\n         \"saved\": saved, \"error\": error},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n    return security.set_csrf_cookie(response, new_cookie)\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef settings_page(request: Request, user=Depends(_require_admin_for_settings)):\n    return _render(request, user, saved=request.query_params.get(\"saved\"))\n\n\n@router.post(\"\")\ndef save_settings(\n    request: Request,\n    theme: str = Form(\"\"),\n    csrf_token: str = Form(\"\"),\n    user=Depends(_require_admin_for_settings),\n):\n    # Fields default to empty rather than being required, so a POST missing\n    # its token gets this page's message, not a 422.\n    if not security.verify_csrf(csrf_token, request.cookies.get(security.CSRF_COOKIE)):\n        return _render(request, user, error=CSRF_EXPIRED_MESSAGE, status_code=403)\n    try:\n        theme_module.select(theme)\n    except theme_module.UnknownTheme:\n        return _render(request, user, error=UNKNOWN_THEME_MESSAGE, status_code=400)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/settings?saved=theme\", status_code=303)\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"0c677672-aae8-45a8-8e00-a1a6725e98f4","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"46a8d74b-d860-4909-a43f-d4dbcfcc3476","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"0008ac86-4a00-4c89-8a62-5971452a5ff3","version":"2.1.305","gitBranch":"mp2plus-f8"}

The public site changes on the next <code>cms publish</code>.</p>{% endif %}\n  {% if error %}<p class=\"error\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ to_root }}admin/settings\" class=\"card settings-form\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token }}\">\n    <fieldset>\n      <legend>Theme</legend>\n      <p class=\"settings-form__hint\">How the public site and this console look. Each theme changes\n        colours and type only; every page keeps its content and links.</p>\n      {% for theme in themes %}\n        <label class=\"theme-option\">\n          <input type=\"radio\" name=\"theme\" value=\"{{ theme.name }}\"{% if theme.name == selected_theme %} checked{% endif %}>\n          <span class=\"theme-option__text\">\n            <span class=\"theme-option__name\">{{ theme.name }}</span>\n            <span class=\"theme-option__description\">{{ theme.description }}</span>\n          </span>\n        </label>\n      {% endfor %}\n    </fieldset>\n    <div class=\"form-actions\">\n      <button type=\"submit\">Save</button>\n    </div>\n  </form>\n{% endblock %}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"dc5bca78-2984-43b9-ad68-515ef75e1614","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"46a8d74b-d860-4909-a43f-d4dbcfcc3476","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"0008ac86-4a00-4c89-8a62-5971452a5ff3","version":"2.1.305","gitBranch":"mp2plus-f8"}

Building it now: the `settings` table, the route, the template, the nav link, and the form's CSS in both themes."},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_012G5GpzBtsevBA3y2Hk48HP","name":"Edit","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\db.py","old_string":"    uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n);\n\"\"\"","new_string":"    uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n);\n\n-- Choices an Admin makes on the Settings page (see CONTEXT.md), one row per\n-- setting, e.g. ('theme', 'chapter'). A missing row means the default.\n-- Unlike the configuration in .env (app/settings.py), these change while\n-- the CMS runs.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (\n    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    value TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\"\"\""},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Vu7SyeinnnG2js6YV5UVDY","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\routes\\admin_settings.py","content":"\"\"\"The admin-only Settings page (MP2plus F8, issue #23): an Admin picks the\nsite's Theme. The choice is stored in the database, so it survives a\nrestart; the admin console shows it on the next page load, and the public\nsite gets it on the next `cms publish`.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import security\nfrom app import theme as theme_module\nfrom app.guards import require_admin\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/settings\")\n\nCSRF_EXPIRED_MESSAGE = \"Your session expired — please try again.\"\nUNKNOWN_THEME_MESSAGE = \"Pick one of the themes listed.\"\n\n\ndef _require_admin_for_settings(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    return require_admin(request, detail=\"Only an Admin can change the site's settings.\")\n\n\ndef _render(request, user, *, saved=None, error=None, status_code=200):\n    csrf_token, new_cookie = security.read_or_mint_csrf(request)\n    response = templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/settings.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Settings\", \"current_user\": user, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token,\n         \"themes\": theme_module.available(), \"selected_theme\": theme_module.selected(),\n         \"saved\": saved, \"error\": error},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n    return security.set_csrf_cookie(response, new_cookie)\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef settings_page(request: Request, user=Depends(_require_admin_for_settings)):\n    return _render(request, user, saved=request.query_params.get(\"saved\"))\n\n\n@router.post(\"\")\ndef save_settings(\n    request: Request,\n    theme: str = Form(\"\"),\n    csrf_token: str = Form(\"\"),\n    user=Depends(_require_admin_for_settings),\n):\n    # Fields default to empty rather than being required, so a POST missing\n    # its token gets this page's message, not a 422.\n    if not security.verify_csrf(csrf_token, request.cookies.get(security.CSRF_COOKIE)):\n        return _render(request, user, error=CSRF_EXPIRED_MESSAGE, status_code=403)\n    try:\n        theme_module.select(theme)\n    except theme_module.UnknownTheme:\n        return _render(request, user, error=UNKNOWN_THEME_MESSAGE, status_code=400)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/settings?saved=theme\", status_code=303)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Rp2uTicLbDcFj9q4xsHtw7","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\templates\\admin\\settings.html","content":"{% extends \"admin/base.html\" %}\n{% block admin_content %}\n  <div class=\"page-head\">\n    <h1>Settings</h1>\n  </div>\n  {% if saved == \"theme\" %}<p class=\"success\">Theme saved. The public site changes on the next <code>cms publish</code>.</p>{% endif %}\n  {% if error %}<p class=\"error\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ to_root }}admin/settings\" class=\"card settings-form\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token }}\">\n    <fieldset>\n      <legend>Theme</legend>\n      <p class=\"settings-form__hint\">How the public site and this console look. Each theme changes\n        colours and type only; every page keeps its content and links.</p>\n      {% for theme in themes %}\n        <label class=\"theme-option\">\n          <input type=\"radio\" name=\"theme\" value=\"{{ theme.name }}\"{% if theme.name == selected_theme %} checked{% endif %}>\n          <span class=\"theme-option__text\">\n            <span class=\"theme-option__name\">{{ theme.name }}</span>\n            <span class=\"theme-option__description\">{{ theme.description }}</span>\n          </span>\n        </label>\n      {% endfor %}\n    </fieldset>\n    <div class=\"form-actions\">\n      <button type=\"submit\">Save</button>\n    </div>\n  </form>\n{% endblock %}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01U7m2p9LinM7667SCGJf6r1","name":"Edit","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My Each test is named after the\nacceptance step it checks:\n\n  1. Two themes exist, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/\n  2. The admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice survives a\n     server restart\n  3. `uv run cms publish` writes the selected theme's CSS as site/style.css,\n     so every page's relative stylesheet link still works\n  4. Switching back and publishing again restores the first theme's CSS\n  5. Both themes show no horizontal overflow at 390 px on the home page and\n     one post\n  6. The Settings form carries a CSRF token; its POST replayed without the\n     token is refused\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf\n\nTHEMES_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / \"app\" / \"themes\"\n\n\ndef _theme_file(name: str) -> bytes:\n    return (THEMES_DIR / name / \"style.css\").read_bytes()\n\n\ndef _theme_options(html: str) -> dict[str, bool]:\n    \"\"\"The Settings page's theme choices: each radio's value, and whether\n    it is the checked one.\"\"\"\n    radios = re.findall(r'<input [^>]*name=\"theme\"[^>]*>', html)\n    return {re.search(r'value=\"([^\"]*)\"', radio).group(1): \" checked\" in radio\n            for radio in radios}\n\n\ndef _choose_theme(admin, name: str):\n    \"\"\"Pick a theme on the Settings page, as an Admin would.\"\"\"\n    token = extract_csrf(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text)\n    return admin.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": name, \"csrf_token\": token},\n                      follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n# -- Step 1: two themes, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/ --\n\ndef test_step1_two_themes_each_one_css_file_in_its_own_folder():\n    folders = sorted(path for path in THEMES_DIR.iterdir() if path.is_dir())\n\n    assert [folder.name for folder in folders] == [\"chapter\", \"default\"]\n    for folder in folders:\n        assert [file.name for file in folder.iterdir()] == [\"style.css\"], folder\n\n\n# -- Step 2: the admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice\n#    survives a server restart --\n\ndef test_step2_an_admin_picks_the_theme_on_the_settings_page(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert _theme_options(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text) == {\n        \"default\": True, \"chapter\": False}\n\n    saved = _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    assert saved.status_code == 303\n    page = admin.get(saved.headers[\"location\"]).text\n    assert \"Theme saved\" in page\n    assert _theme_options(page) == {\"default\": False, \"chapter\": Each test is named after the\nacceptance step it checks:\n\n  1. Two themes exist, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/\n  2. The admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice survives a\n     server restart\n  3. `uv run cms publish` writes the selected theme's CSS as site/style.css,\n     so every page's relative stylesheet link still works\n  4. Switching back and publishing again restores the first theme's CSS\n  5. Both themes show no horizontal overflow at 390 px on the home page and\n     one post\n  6. The Settings form carries a CSRF token; its POST replayed without the\n     token is refused\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf\n\nTHEMES_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / \"app\" / \"themes\"\n\n\ndef _theme_file(name: str) -> bytes:\n    return (THEMES_DIR / name / \"style.css\").read_bytes()\n\n\ndef _theme_options(html: str) -> dict[str, bool]:\n    \"\"\"The Settings page's theme choices: each radio's value, and whether\n    it is the checked one.\"\"\"\n    radios = re.findall(r'<input [^>]*name=\"theme\"[^>]*>', html)\n    return {re.search(r'value=\"([^\"]*)\"', radio).group(1): \" checked\" in radio\n            for radio in radios}\n\n\ndef _choose_theme(admin, name: str):\n    \"\"\"Pick a theme on the Settings page, as an Admin would.\"\"\"\n    token = extract_csrf(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text)\n    return admin.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": name, \"csrf_token\": token},\n                      follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n# -- Step 1: two themes, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/ --\n\ndef test_step1_two_themes_each_one_css_file_in_its_own_folder():\n    folders = sorted(path for path in THEMES_DIR.iterdir() if path.is_dir())\n\n    assert [folder.name for folder in folders] == [\"chapter\", \"default\"]\n    for folder in folders:\n        assert [file.name for file in folder.iterdir()] == [\"style.css\"], folder\n\n\n# -- Step 2: the admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice\n#    survives a server restart --\n\ndef test_step2_an_admin_picks_the_theme_on_the_settings_page(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert _theme_options(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text) == {\n        \"default\": True, \"chapter\": False}\n\n    saved = _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    assert saved.status_code == 303\n    page = admin.get(saved.headers[\"location\"]).text\n    assert \"Theme saved\" in page\n    assert _theme_options(page) == {\"default\": False, \"chapter\": True}\n\n\ndef test_step2_the_console_and_the_preview_load_the_chosen_theme(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert admin.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n\n    _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    response = admin.get(\"/style.css\")\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/css\")\n    assert response.content == Each test is named after the\nacceptance step it checks:\n\n  1. Two themes exist, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/\n  2. The admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice survives a\n     server restart\n  3. `uv run cms publish` writes the selected theme's CSS as site/style.css,\n     so every page's relative stylesheet link still works\n  4. Switching back and publishing again restores the first theme's CSS\n  5. Both themes show no horizontal overflow at 390 px on the home page and\n     one post\n  6. The Settings form carries a CSRF token; its POST replayed without the\n     token is refused\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf\n\nTHEMES_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / \"app\" / \"themes\"\n\n\ndef _theme_file(name: str) -> bytes:\n    return (THEMES_DIR / name / \"style.css\").read_bytes()\n\n\ndef _theme_options(html: str) -> dict[str, bool]:\n    \"\"\"The Settings page's theme choices: each radio's value, and whether\n    it is the checked one.\"\"\"\n    radios = re.findall(r'<input [^>]*name=\"theme\"[^>]*>', html)\n    return {re.search(r'value=\"([^\"]*)\"', radio).group(1): \" checked\" in radio\n            for radio in radios}\n\n\ndef _choose_theme(admin, name: str):\n    \"\"\"Pick a theme on the Settings page, as an Admin would.\"\"\"\n    token = extract_csrf(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text)\n    return admin.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": name, \"csrf_token\": token},\n                      follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n# -- Step 1: two themes, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/ --\n\ndef test_step1_two_themes_each_one_css_file_in_its_own_folder():\n    folders = sorted(path for path in THEMES_DIR.iterdir() if path.is_dir())\n\n    assert [folder.name for folder in folders] == [\"chapter\", \"default\"]\n    for folder in folders:\n        assert [file.name for file in folder.iterdir()] == [\"style.css\"], folder\n\n\n# -- Step 2: the admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice\n#    survives a server restart --\n\ndef test_step2_an_admin_picks_the_theme_on_the_settings_page(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert _theme_options(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text) == {\n        \"default\": True, \"chapter\": False}\n\n    saved = _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    assert saved.status_code == 303\n    page = admin.get(saved.headers[\"location\"]).text\n    assert \"Theme saved\" in page\n    assert _theme_options(page) == {\"default\": False, \"chapter\": True}\n\n\ndef test_step2_the_console_and_the_preview_load_the_chosen_theme(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert admin.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n\n    _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    response = admin.get(\"/style.css\")\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/css\")\n    assert response.content == _theme_file(\"chapter\")\n\n\n# A server started afresh: a new Python process on the same database, so\n# nothing held in the first process's memory can carry the choice over.\nRESTARTED_SERVER = \"\"\"\nimport sys\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\nfrom app.main import create_app\nsys.stdout.buffer.write(TestClient(create_app()).get(\"/style.css\").content)\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef test_step2_the_choice_survives_a_server_restart(client_as):\n    _choose_theme(client_as(\"admin\"), \"chapter\")\n\n    restarted = subprocess.run(\n        [sys.executable, \"-c\", RESTARTED_SERVER], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True,\n        env={**os.environ, \"CMS_DATABASE\": str(settings.DATABASE_PATH)}, timeout=60,\n    )\n\n    assert restarted.returncode == 0, restarted.stderr.decode(errors=\"replace\")\n    assert restarted.stdout == _theme_file(\"chapter\")\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":14,"oldLines":12,"newStart":14,"newLines":17,"lines":[" \"\"\""," \"Pick one of the themes listed\" in refused.text\n    assert admin.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n","originalFile":"\"\"\"MP2plus F8: Switchable theme (issue #23). Each test is named after the\nacceptance step it checks:\n\n  1. Two themes exist, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/\n  2. The admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice survives a\n     server restart\n  3. `uv run cms publish` writes the selected theme's CSS as site/style.css,\n     so every page's relative stylesheet link still works\n  4. Switching back and publishing again restores the first theme's CSS\n  5. Both themes show no horizontal overflow at 390 px on the home page and\n     one post\n  6. The Settings form carries a CSRF token; its POST replayed without the\n     token is refused\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nTHEMES_DIR = ROOT / \"app\" / \"themes\"\n\n\ndef _theme_file(name: str) -> bytes:\n    return (THEMES_DIR / name / \"style.css\").read_bytes()\n\n\ndef _theme_options(html: str) -> dict[str, bool]:\n    \"\"\"The Settings page's theme choices: each radio's value, and whether\n    it is the checked one.\"\"\"\n    radios = re.findall(r'<input [^>]*name=\"theme\"[^>]*>', html)\n    return {re.search(r'value=\"([^\"]*)\"', radio).group(1): \" checked\" in radio\n            for radio in radios}\n\n\ndef _choose_theme(admin, name: str):\n    \"\"\"Pick a theme on the Settings page, as an Admin would.\"\"\"\n    token = extract_csrf(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text)\n    return admin.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": name, \"csrf_token\": token},\n                      follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n# -- Step 1: two themes, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/ --\n\ndef test_step1_two_themes_each_one_css_file_in_its_own_folder():\n    folders = sorted(path for path in THEMES_DIR.iterdir() if path.is_dir())\n\n    assert [folder.name for folder in folders] == [\"chapter\", \"default\"]\n    for folder in folders:\n        assert [file.name for file in folder.iterdir()] == [\"style.css\"], folder\n\n\n# -- Step 2: the admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice\n#    survives a server restart --\n\ndef test_step2_an_admin_picks_the_theme_on_the_settings_page(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert _theme_options(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text) == {\n        \"default\": True, \"chapter\": False}\n\n    saved = _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    assert saved.status_code == 303\n    page = admin.get(saved.headers[\"location\"]).text\n    assert \"Theme saved\" in page\n    assert _theme_options(page) == {\"default\": False, \"chapter\": True}\n\n\ndef test_step2_the_console_and_the_preview_load_the_chosen_theme(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert admin.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n\n    _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    response = admin.get(\"/style.css\")\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/css\")\n    assert response.content == _theme_file(\"chapter\")\n\n\n# A server started afresh: a new Python process on the same database, so\n# nothing held in the first process's memory can carry the choice over.\nRESTARTED_SERVER = \"\"\"\nimport sys\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\nfrom app.main import
