Each test is named after the\nacceptance step it checks:\n\n  1. Two themes exist, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/\n  2. The admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice survives a\n     server restart\n  3. `uv run cms publish` writes the selected theme's CSS as site/style.css,\n     so every page's relative stylesheet link still works\n  4. Switching back and publishing again restores the first theme's CSS\n  5. Both themes show no horizontal overflow at 390 px on the home page and\n     one post\n  6. The Settings form carries a CSRF token; its POST replayed without the\n     token is refused\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nTHEMES_DIR = ROOT / \"app\" / \"themes\"\n\n\ndef _theme_file(name: str) -> bytes:\n    return (THEMES_DIR / name / \"style.css\").read_bytes()\n\n\ndef _theme_options(html: str) -> dict[str, bool]:\n    \"\"\"The Settings page's theme choices: each radio's value, and whether\n    it is the checked one.\"\"\"\n    radios = re.findall(r'<input [^>]*name=\"theme\"[^>]*>', html)\n    return {re.search(r'value=\"([^\"]*)\"', radio).group(1): \" checked\" in radio\n            for radio in radios}\n\n\ndef _choose_theme(admin, name: str):\n    \"\"\"Pick a theme on the Settings page, as an Admin would.\"\"\"\n    token = extract_csrf(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text)\n    return admin.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": name, \"csrf_token\": token},\n                      follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n# -- Step 1: two themes, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/ --\n\ndef test_step1_two_themes_each_one_css_file_in_its_own_folder():\n    folders = sorted(path for path in THEMES_DIR.iterdir() if path.is_dir())\n\n    assert [folder.name for folder in folders] == [\"chapter\", \"default\"]\n    for folder in folders:\n        assert [file.name for file in folder.iterdir()] == [\"style.css\"], folder\n\n\n# -- Step 2: the admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice\n#    survives a server restart --\n\ndef test_step2_an_admin_picks_the_theme_on_the_settings_page(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert _theme_options(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text) == {\n        \"default\": True, \"chapter\": False}\n\n    saved = _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    assert saved.status_code == 303\n    page = admin.get(saved.headers[\"location\"]).text\n    assert \"Theme saved\" in page\n    assert _theme_options(page) == {\"default\": False, \"chapter\": True}\n\n\ndef test_step2_the_console_and_the_preview_load_the_chosen_theme(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert admin.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n\n    _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    response = admin.get(\"/style.css\")\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/css\")\n    assert response.content == _theme_file(\"chapter\")\n\n\n# A server started afresh: a new Python process on the same database, so\n# nothing held in the first process's memory can carry the choice over.\nRESTARTED_SERVER = \"\"\"\nimport sys\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\nfrom app.main import create_app\nsys.stdout.buffer.write(TestClient(create_app()).get(\"/style.css\").content)\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef test_step2_the_choice_survives_a_server_restart(client_as):\n    _choose_theme(client_as(\"admin\"), \"chapter\")\n\n    restarted = subprocess.run(\n        [sys.executable, \"-c\", RESTARTED_SERVER], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True,\n        env={**os.environ, \"CMS_DATABASE\": str(settings.DATABASE_PATH)}, timeout=60,\n    )\n\n    assert restarted.returncode == 0, restarted.stderr.decode(errors=\"replace\")\n    assert restarted.stdout == _theme_file(\"chapter\")\n\n\ndef test_step2_an_editor_can_neither_open_nor_post_the_settings_page(client_as, client):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    token = extract_csrf(editor.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n    assert editor.get(\"/admin/settings\").status_code == 403\n    refused = editor.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": \"chapter\", \"csrf_token\": token})\n    assert refused.status_code == 403\n    assert \"Only an Admin\" in refused.text\n    assert client.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n\n\ndef test_step2_an_anonymous_visitor_is_sent_to_log_in(client):\n    for response in (client.get(\"/admin/settings\", follow_redirects=False),\n                     client.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": \"chapter\"},\n                                 follow_redirects=False)):\n        assert response.status_code == 303\n        assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\n    assert client.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n\n\ndef test_step2_only_admins_see_settings_in_the_nav(client_as):\n    assert 'href=\"admin/settings\"' in client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert \"admin/settings\" not in client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin\").text\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"name\", [\"\", \"nope\", \"../default\", \"default/../chapter\"])\ndef test_step2_a_theme_that_is_not_listed_is_refused(client_as, name):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n\n    refused = _choose_theme(admin, name)\n\n    assert refused.status_code == 400\n    assert \"Pick one of the themes listed\" in refused.text\n    assert admin.get(\"/style.css\").content == The admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice survives a\n     server restart\n  3. `uv run cms publish` writes the selected theme's CSS as site/style.css,\n     so every page's relative stylesheet link still works\n  4. Switching back and publishing again restores the first theme's CSS\n  5. Both themes show no horizontal overflow at 390 px on the home page and\n     one post\n  6. The Settings form carries a CSRF token; its POST replayed without the\n     token is refused\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nTHEMES_DIR = ROOT / \"app\" / \"themes\"\n\n\ndef _theme_file(name: str) -> bytes:\n    return (THEMES_DIR / name / \"style.css\").read_bytes()\n\n\ndef _theme_options(html: str) -> dict[str, bool]:\n    \"\"\"The Settings page's theme choices: each radio's value, and whether\n    it is the checked one.\"\"\"\n    radios = re.findall(r'<input [^>]*name=\"theme\"[^>]*>', html)\n    return {re.search(r'value=\"([^\"]*)\"', radio).group(1): \" checked\" in radio\n            for radio in radios}\n\n\ndef _choose_theme(admin, name: str):\n    \"\"\"Pick a theme on the Settings page, as an Admin would.\"\"\"\n    token = extract_csrf(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text)\n    return admin.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": name, \"csrf_token\": token},\n                      follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n# -- Step 1: two themes, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/ --\n\ndef test_step1_two_themes_each_one_css_file_in_its_own_folder():\n    folders = sorted(path for path in THEMES_DIR.iterdir() if path.is_dir())\n\n    assert [folder.name for folder in folders] == [\"chapter\", \"default\"]\n    for folder in folders:\n        assert [file.name for file in folder.iterdir()] == [\"style.css\"], folder\n\n\n# -- Step 2: the admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice\n#    survives a server restart --\n\ndef test_step2_an_admin_picks_the_theme_on_the_settings_page(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert _theme_options(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text) == {\n        \"default\": True, \"chapter\": False}\n\n    saved = _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    assert saved.status_code == 303\n    page = admin.get(saved.headers[\"location\"]).text\n    assert \"Theme saved\" in nothing held in the first process's memory can carry the choice over.\nRESTARTED_SERVER = \"\"\"\nimport sys\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\nfrom app.main import create_app\nsys.stdout.buffer.write(TestClient(create_app()).get(\"/style.css\").content)\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef test_step2_the_choice_survives_a_server_restart(client_as):\n    _choose_theme(client_as(\"admin\"), \"chapter\")\n\n    restarted = subprocess.run(\n        [sys.executable, \"-c\", RESTARTED_SERVER], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True,\n        env={**os.environ, \"CMS_DATABASE\": str(settings.DATABASE_PATH)}, timeout=60,\n    )\n\n    assert restarted.returncode == 0, restarted.stderr.decode(errors=\"replace\")\n    assert restarted.stdout == _theme_file(\"chapter\")\n\n\ndef test_step2_an_editor_can_neither_open_nor_post_the_settings_page(client_as, client):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    token = (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"b64f4aeb-98d1-43d3-a0b1-97f2c8577e67","timestamp":"2026-10-21T06:27:51.512Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\publish.py","oldString":"    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    shutil.copyfile(theme_module.stylesheet(theme_module.DEFAULT_THEME), out / \"style.css\")","newString":"    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    # The selected Theme's file, byte for byte, under the one name every\n    # page links: switching themes changes the file, never the links.\n    shutil.copyfile(theme_module.stylesheet(), out / \"style.css\")","originalFile":"\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nT00 publishes a placeholder home page. As you build content types, extend\nrender_site() to write one file per published item. Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n     That includes links written in a body: render_markdown(..., to_root=...)\n     rewrites \"/contact-us.html\" and \"media/logo.png\" for the file it lands in.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app import theme as theme_module\nfrom app.mdrender import render_markdown, render_text\n\n# search.html's one script, which searches site/search-index.json.\nSEARCH_JS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"search.js\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n# The most characters of a body that search.html shows under a result's title.\nEXCERPT_LENGTH = 160\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef nav_items(prefix: str = \"\") -> list[dict[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Published Pages, as relative (title, href) links for the public\n    site's nav. `prefix` relocates the link for a page nested one\n    directory deep (e.g. \"../\" from site/posts/*.html) — a draft Page\n    never appears here.\"\"\"\n    return [{\"title\": page[\"title\"], \"href\": f\"{prefix}{page['slug']}.html\"}\n            for page in _exportable_pages()]\n\n\ndef _exportable_pages() -> list:\n    # The editor already refuses reserved slugs; this also covers rows saved\n    # before that check existed, so a Page can never overwrite site/index.html.\n    return [page for page in content_module.list_published(\"page\")\n            if not content_module.reserved_slug_reason(\"page\", page[\"slug\"])]\n\n\ndef _date(item) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The calendar day an item was created, e.g. \"2026-10-07\".\"\"\"\n    return item[\"created_at\"][:10]\n\n\ndef home_html() -> str:\n    \"\"\"The home page (feed of published Posts), as written to site/index.html.\"\"\"\n    posts = content_module.list_published(\"post\")\n    return environment().get_template(\"public/home.html\").render(\n        title=settings.SITE_TITLE, items=[\n            {\"title\": post[\"title\"], \"href\": f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\",\n             \"date\": _date(post)} for post in posts\n        ],\n        css_path=\"style.css\", home_path=\"index.html\", nav_items=nav_items(),\n    )\n\n\ndef search_html() -> str:\n    \"\"\"The search page, as written to site/search.html; its script is\n    site/search.js.\"\"\"\n    return environment().get_template(\"public/search.html\").render(\n        title=\"Search\", site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n        css_path=\"style.css\", home_path=\"index.html\", nav_items=nav_items(),\n    )\n\n\ndef search_index_json() -> str:\n    \"\"\"site/search-index.json: the title, URL and a plain-text excerpt of\n    every published Post and Page, for search.html's script to search. Each\n    URL is relative to the site root, where search.html is.\"\"\"\n    items = [(post, f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\")\n             for post in content_module.list_published(\"post\")]\n    items += [(page, f\"{page['slug']}.html\") for page in _exportable_pages()]\n    return json.dumps([\n        {\"title\": item[\"title\"], \"url\": url, \"excerpt\": _excerpt(item[\"body_md\"])}\n        for item, url in items\n    ], ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)\n\n\ndef _excerpt(body_md: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The start of a body as plain text, EXCERPT_LENGTH characters or fewer\n    with the \"…\" that ends it when anything was cut. The cut falls at a word\n    break, unless the text has none to fall at.\"\"\"\n    text = render_text(body_md)\n    if len(text) <= EXCERPT_LENGTH:\n        return text\n    head = text[:EXCERPT_LENGTH]\n    cut = head.rsplit(\" \", 1)[0] if \" \" in head else head[:-1]\n    return (cut.rstrip(\" .,;:\") or cut) + \"…\"\n\n\ndef post_html(post) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A published Post, as written to site/posts/<slug>.html — one directory\n    deep, so every shared link climbs a level.\"\"\"\n    return _detail_html(\"public/post.html\", \"post\", post, prefix=\"../\")\n\n\ndef page_html(page) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A published Page, as written to site/<slug>.html.\"\"\"\n    return _detail_html(\"public/page.html\", \"page\", page, prefix=\"\")\n\n\ndef _detail_html(template_name: str, item_key: str, item, *, prefix: str) -> str:\n    return environment().get_template(template_name).render(\n        title=item[\"title\"], site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n        **{item_key: item}, date=_date(item),\n        body_html=render_markdown(item[\"body_md\"], to_root=prefix),\n        css_path=f\"{prefix}style.css\", home_path=f\"{prefix}index.html\",\n        nav_items=nav_items(prefix=prefix),\n    )\n\n\ndef _write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:\n    # Explicit UTF-8: the pages declare <meta charset=\"utf-8\">, and the\n    # platform default (cp1252 on Windows) can't encode an emoji at all.\n    path.write_text(text, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    shutil.copyfile(theme_module.stylesheet(theme_module.DEFAULT_THEME), out / \"style.css\")\n    _write(out / \"index.html\", home_html())\n    _write(out / \"search.html\", search_html())\n    _write(out / \"search.js\", SEARCH_JS)\n    _write(out / \"search-index.json\", search_index_json())\n\n    posts_dir = out / \"posts\"\n    posts_dir.mkdir()\n    for post in content_module.list_published(\"post\"):\n        _write(posts_dir / f\"{post['slug']}.html\", post_html(post))\n    for page in _exportable_pages():\n        _write(out / f\"{page['slug']}.html\", page_html(page))\n\n    # Every file in media/ is meant to be public; Posts show them through\n    # their Media library snippets.\n    if settings.MEDIA.is_dir():\n        shutil.copytree(settings.MEDIA, out / \"media\")\n\n    return out\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":135,"oldLines":7,"newStart":135,"newLines":9,"lines":["     if out.exists():","         shutil.rmtree(out)","     out.mkdir(parents=True)","-    shutil.copyfile(theme_module.stylesheet(theme_module.DEFAULT_THEME), out / \"style.css\")","+    # Each test is named after the\nacceptance step it checks:\n\n  1. Two themes exist, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/\n  2. The admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice survives a\n     server restart\n  3. `uv run cms publish` writes the selected theme's CSS as site/style.css,\n     so every page's relative stylesheet link still works\n  4. Switching back and publishing again restores the first theme's CSS\n  5. Both themes show no horizontal overflow at 390 px on the home page and\n     one post\n  6. The Settings form carries a CSRF token; its POST replayed without the\n     token is refused\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import cli, settings\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf\nfrom tests.test_phone_width import awkward_content  # noqa: F401 (a fixture)\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nTHEMES_DIR = ROOT / \"app\" / \"themes\"\n\n\ndef _theme_file(name: str) -> bytes:\n    return (THEMES_DIR / name / \"style.css\").read_bytes()\n\n\ndef _theme_options(html: str) -> dict[str, bool]:\n    \"\"\"The Settings page's theme choices: each radio's value, and whether\n    it is the checked one.\"\"\"\n    radios = re.findall(r'<input [^>]*name=\"theme\"[^>]*>', html)\n    return {re.search(r'value=\"([^\"]*)\"', radio).group(1): \" checked\" in radio\n            for radio in radios}\n\n\ndef _choose_theme(admin, name: str):\n    \"\"\"Pick a theme on the Settings page, as an Admin would.\"\"\"\n    token = extract_csrf(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text)\n    return admin.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": name, \"csrf_token\": token},\n                      follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n# -- Step 1: two themes, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/ --\n\ndef test_step1_two_themes_each_one_css_file_in_its_own_folder():\n    folders = sorted(path for path in THEMES_DIR.iterdir() if path.is_dir())\n\n    assert [folder.name for folder in folders] == [\"chapter\", \"default\"]\n    for folder in folders:\n        assert [file.name for file in folder.iterdir()] == [\"style.css\"], folder\n\n\n# -- Step 2: the admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice\n#    survives a server restart --\n\ndef test_step2_an_admin_picks_the_theme_on_the_settings_page(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert _theme_options(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text) == {\n        \"default\": True, \"chapter\": False}\n\n    saved = _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    assert saved.status_code == 303\n    page = admin.get(saved.headers[\"location\"]).text\n    assert \"Theme saved\" in page\n    assert _theme_options(page) == {\"default\": False, \"chapter\": True}\n\n\ndef test_step2_the_console_and_the_preview_load_the_chosen_theme(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert admin.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n\n    _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    response = admin.get(\"/style.css\")\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/css\")\n    assert response.content == _theme_file(\"chapter\")\n\n\n# A server started afresh: a new Python process on the same database, so\n# nothing held in the first process's memory can carry the choice over.\nRESTARTED_SERVER = \"\"\"\nimport sys\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\nfrom app.main import create_app\nsys.stdout.buffer.write(TestClient(create_app()).get(\"/style.css\").content)\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef test_step2_the_choice_survives_a_server_restart(client_as):\n    _choose_theme(client_as(\"admin\"), \"chapter\")\n\n    restarted = subprocess.run(\n        [sys.executable, \"-c\", RESTARTED_SERVER], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True,\n        env={**os.environ, \"CMS_DATABASE\": str(settings.DATABASE_PATH)}, timeout=60,\n    )\n\n    assert restarted.returncode == 0, restarted.stderr.decode(errors=\"replace\")\n    assert restarted.stdout == _theme_file(\"chapter\")\n\n\ndef test_step2_an_editor_can_neither_open_nor_post_the_settings_page(client_as, client):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    token = extract_csrf(editor.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n    assert editor.get(\"/admin/settings\").status_code == 403\n    refused = editor.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": \"chapter\", \"csrf_token\": token})\n    assert refused.status_code == 403\n    assert \"Only an Admin\" in refused.text\n    assert client.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n\n\ndef test_step2_an_anonymous_visitor_is_sent_to_log_in(client):\n    for response in (client.get(\"/admin/settings\", follow_redirects=False),\n                     client.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": \"chapter\"},\n                                 follow_redirects=False)):\n        assert response.status_code == 303\n        assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\n    assert client.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n\n\ndef test_step2_only_admins_see_settings_in_the_nav(client_as):\n    assert 'href=\"admin/settings\"' in client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert \"admin/settings\" not in client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin\").text\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"name\", [\"\", \"nope\", \"../default\", \"default/../chapter\"])\ndef test_step2_a_theme_that_is_not_listed_is_refused(client_as, name):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n\n    refused = _choose_theme(admin, name)\n\n    assert refused.status_code == 400\n    assert \"Pick one of the themes listed\" in refused.text\n    assert admin.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n\n\n# -- Step 3: `cms publish` writes the selected theme's CSS as site/style.css,\n#    so every page's relative stylesheet link still works --\n\ndef _publish(monkeypatch, tmp_path) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Run `cms publish` into a site/ of this test's own.\"\"\"\n    site = tmp_path / \"site\"\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", site)\n    assert cli.main([\"publish\"]) == 0\n    return site\n\n\ndef test_step3_publish_writes_the_selected_themes_css_as_site_style_css(\n    client_as, monkeypatch, tmp_path,\n):\n    _choose_theme(client_as(\"admin\"), \"chapter\")\n\n    site = _publish(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n\n    assert (site / \"style.css\").read_bytes() == _theme_file(\"chapter\")\n\n\ndef test_step3_every_exported_page_links_that_stylesheet_relatively(\n    client_as, awkward_content, monkeypatch, tmp_path,\n):\n    _choose_theme(client_as(\"admin\"), \"chapter\")\n\n    site = _publish(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n\n    pages = sorted(site.rglob(\"*.html\"))\n    assert {page.relative_to(site).as_posix() for page in pages} == {\n        \"index.html\", \"search.html\", \"posts/wide-post.html\", \"wide-page.html\"}\n    for page in pages:\n        href = re.search(r'<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"([^\"]+)\">',\n                         page.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")).group(1)\n        assert not href.startswith(\"/\"), page\n        assert (page.parent / href).resolve() == (site / \"style.css\").resolve(), page\n\n\n# -- Step 4: switching back and publishing again restores the first theme's CSS --\n\ndef test_step4_switching_back_and_publishing_again_restores_the_first_theme(\n    client_as, monkeypatch, tmp_path,\n):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n    site = _publish(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n    assert (site / \"style.css\").read_bytes() == _theme_file(\"chapter\")\n\n    _choose_theme(admin, \"default\")\n    _publish(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n\n    assert The admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice survives a\n     server restart\n  3. `uv run cms publish` writes the selected theme's CSS as site/style.css,\n     so every page's relative stylesheet link still works\n  4. Switching back and publishing again restores the first theme's CSS\n  5. Both themes show no horizontal overflow at 390 px on the home page and\n     one post\n  6. The Settings form carries a CSRF token; its POST replayed without the\n     token is refused\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import cli, settings\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf\nfrom tests.test_phone_width import awkward_content  # noqa: F401 (a fixture)\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nTHEMES_DIR = ROOT / \"app\" / \"themes\"\n\n\ndef _theme_file(name: str) -> bytes:\n    return (THEMES_DIR / name / \"style.css\").read_bytes()\n\n\ndef _theme_options(html: str) -> dict[str, bool]:\n    \"\"\"The Settings page's theme choices: each radio's value, and whether\n    it is the checked one.\"\"\"\n    radios = re.findall(r'<input [^>]*name=\"theme\"[^>]*>', html)\n    return {re.search(r'value=\"([^\"]*)\"', radio).group(1): \" checked\" in radio\n            for radio in radios}\n\n\ndef _choose_theme(admin, name: str):\n    \"\"\"Pick a theme on the Settings page, as an Admin would.\"\"\"\n    token = extract_csrf(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text)\n    return admin.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": name, \"csrf_token\": token},\n                      follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n# -- Step 1: two themes, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/ --\n\ndef test_step1_two_themes_each_one_css_file_in_its_own_folder():\n    folders = sorted(path for path in THEMES_DIR.iterdir() if path.is_dir())\n\n    assert [folder.name for folder in folders] == [\"chapter\", \"default\"]\n    for folder in folders:\n        assert [file.name for file in folder.iterdir()] == [\"style.css\"], folder\n\n\n# -- Step 2: the admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice\n#    survives a server restart --\n\ndef test_step2_an_admin_picks_the_theme_on_the_settings_page(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert _theme_options(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text) == {\n        \"default\": True, \"chapter\": False}\n\n    saved = _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    assert saved.status_code == 303\n    page = admin.get(saved.headers[\"location\"]).text\n    assert \"Theme saved\" in page\n    assert _theme_options(page) == {\"default\": False, \"chapter\": True}\n\n\ndef test_step2_the_console_and_the_preview_load_the_chosen_theme(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert admin.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n\n    _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    response = admin.get(\"/style.css\")\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/css\")\n    assert response.content == _theme_file(\"chapter\")\n\n\n# A server started afresh: a new Python process on the same database, so\n# nothing held in the first process's memory can carry the choice over.\nRESTARTED_SERVER = \"\"\"\nimport sys\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\nfrom app.main import create_app\nsys.stdout.buffer.write(TestClient(create_app()).get(\"/style.css\").content)\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef test_step2_the_choice_survives_a_server_restart(client_as):\n    _choose_theme(client_as(\"admin\"), \"chapter\")\n\n    restarted = subprocess.run(\n        [sys.executable, \"-c\", RESTARTED_SERVER], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True,\n        env={**os.environ, \"CMS_DATABASE\": str(settings.DATABASE_PATH)}, timeout=60,\n    )\n\n    assert restarted.returncode == 0, restarted.stderr.decode(errors=\"replace\")\n    assert restarted.stdout == _theme_file(\"chapter\")\n\n\ndef test_step2_an_editor_can_neither_open_nor_post_the_settings_page(client_as, client):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    token = extract_csrf(editor.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n    assert editor.get(\"/admin/settings\").status_code == 403\n    refused = editor.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": \"chapter\", \"csrf_token\": token})\n    assert refused.status_code == 403\n    assert \"Only an Admin\" in refused.text\n    assert client.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n\n\ndef test_step2_an_anonymous_visitor_is_sent_to_log_in(client):\n    for response in (client.get(\"/admin/settings\", follow_redirects=False),\n                     client.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": \"chapter\"},\n                                 follow_redirects=False)):\n        assert response.status_code == 303\n        assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\n    assert client.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n\n\ndef test_step2_only_admins_see_settings_in_the_nav(client_as):\n    assert 'href=\"admin/settings\"' in client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert \"admin/settings\" not in client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin\").text\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"name\", [\"\", name)\n\n    assert refused.status_code == 400\n    assert \"Pick one of the themes listed\" in refused.text\n    assert admin.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n\n\n# -- Step 3: Each test is named after the\nacceptance step it checks:\n\n  1. Two themes exist, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/\n  2. The admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice survives a\n     server restart\n  3. `uv run cms publish` writes the selected theme's CSS as site/style.css,\n     so every page's relative stylesheet link still works\n  4. Switching back and publishing again restores the first theme's CSS\n  5. Both themes show no horizontal overflow at 390 px on the home page and\n     one post\n  6. The Settings form carries a CSRF token; its POST replayed without the\n     token is refused\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import cli, settings\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf, log_in\nfrom tests.test_phone_width import assert_fits_phone\nfrom tests.test_phone_width import awkward_content  # noqa: F401 (a fixture)\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nTHEMES_DIR = ROOT / \"app\" / \"themes\"\n\n\ndef _theme_file(name: str) -> bytes:\n    return (THEMES_DIR / name / \"style.css\").read_bytes()\n\n\ndef _theme_options(html: str) -> dict[str, bool]:\n    \"\"\"The Settings page's theme choices: each radio's value, and whether\n    it is the checked one.\"\"\"\n    radios = re.findall(r'<input [^>]*name=\"theme\"[^>]*>', html)\n    return {re.search(r'value=\"([^\"]*)\"', radio).group(1): \" checked\" in radio\n            for radio in radios}\n\n\ndef _choose_theme(admin, name: str):\n    \"\"\"Pick a theme on the Settings page, as an Admin would.\"\"\"\n    token = extract_csrf(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text)\n    return admin.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": name, \"csrf_token\": token},\n                      follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n# -- Step 1: two themes, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/ --\n\ndef test_step1_two_themes_each_one_css_file_in_its_own_folder():\n    folders = sorted(path for path in THEMES_DIR.iterdir() if path.is_dir())\n\n    assert [folder.name for folder in folders] == [\"chapter\", \"default\"]\n    for folder in folders:\n        assert [file.name for file in folder.iterdir()] == [\"style.css\"], folder\n\n\n# -- Step 2: the admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice\n#    survives a server restart --\n\ndef test_step2_an_admin_picks_the_theme_on_the_settings_page(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert _theme_options(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text) == {\n        \"default\": True, \"chapter\": False}\n\n    saved = _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    assert saved.status_code == 303\n    page = admin.get(saved.headers[\"location\"]).text\n    assert \"Theme saved\" in page\n    assert _theme_options(page) == {\"default\": False, \"chapter\": True}\n\n\ndef test_step2_the_console_and_the_preview_load_the_chosen_theme(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert admin.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n\n    _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    response = admin.get(\"/style.css\")\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/css\")\n    assert response.content == _theme_file(\"chapter\")\n\n\n# A server started afresh: a new Python process on the same database, so\n# nothing held in the first process's memory can carry the choice over.\nRESTARTED_SERVER = \"\"\"\nimport sys\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\nfrom app.main import create_app\nsys.stdout.buffer.write(TestClient(create_app()).get(\"/style.css\").content)\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef test_step2_the_choice_survives_a_server_restart(client_as):\n    _choose_theme(client_as(\"admin\"), \"chapter\")\n\n    restarted = subprocess.run(\n        [sys.executable, \"-c\", RESTARTED_SERVER], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True,\n        env={**os.environ, \"CMS_DATABASE\": str(settings.DATABASE_PATH)}, timeout=60,\n    )\n\n    assert restarted.returncode == 0, restarted.stderr.decode(errors=\"replace\")\n    assert restarted.stdout == _theme_file(\"chapter\")\n\n\ndef test_step2_an_editor_can_neither_open_nor_post_the_settings_page(client_as, client):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    token = extract_csrf(editor.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n    assert editor.get(\"/admin/settings\").status_code == 403\n    refused = editor.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": \"chapter\", \"csrf_token\": disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\tests\\test_theme.py","content":"\"\"\"MP2plus F8: Switchable theme (issue #23). Each test is named after the\nacceptance step it checks:\n\n  1. Two themes exist, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/\n  2. The admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice survives a\n     server restart\n  3. `uv run cms publish` writes the selected theme's CSS as site/style.css,\n     so every page's relative stylesheet link still works\n  4. Switching back and publishing again restores the first theme's CSS\n  5. Both themes show no horizontal overflow at 390 px on the home page and\n     one post\n  6. The Settings form carries a CSRF token; its POST replayed without the\n     token is refused\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import cli, settings\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf, log_in\nfrom tests.test_phone_width import assert_fits_phone\nfrom tests.test_phone_width import awkward_content  # noqa: F401 (a fixture)\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nTHEMES_DIR = ROOT / \"app\" / \"themes\"\n\n\ndef _theme_file(name: str) -> bytes:\n    return (THEMES_DIR / name / \"style.css\").read_bytes()\n\n\ndef _theme_options(html: str) -> dict[str, bool]:\n    \"\"\"The Settings page's theme choices: each radio's value, and whether\n    it is the checked one.\"\"\"\n    radios = re.findall(r'<input [^>]*name=\"theme\"[^>]*>', html)\n    return {re.search(r'value=\"([^\"]*)\"', radio).group(1): \" checked\" in radio\n            for radio in radios}\n\n\ndef _choose_theme(admin, name: str):\n    \"\"\"Pick a theme on the Settings page, as an Admin would.\"\"\"\n    token = extract_csrf(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text)\n    return admin.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": name, \"csrf_token\": token},\n                      follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n# -- Step 1: two themes, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/ --\n\ndef test_step1_two_themes_each_one_css_file_in_its_own_folder():\n    folders = sorted(path for path in THEMES_DIR.iterdir() if path.is_dir())\n\n    assert [folder.name for folder in folders] == [\"chapter\", \"default\"]\n    for folder in folders:\n        assert [file.name for file in folder.iterdir()] == [\"style.css\"], folder\n\n\n# -- Step 2: the admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice\n#    survives a server restart --\n\ndef test_step2_an_admin_picks_the_theme_on_the_settings_page(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert _theme_options(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text) == {\n        \"default\": True, \"chapter\": in folders] == [\"chapter\", \"default\"]\n    for folder in folders:\n        assert [file.name for file in folder.iterdir()] == [\"style.css\"], folder\n\n\ndef _classes(name: str) -> set[str]:\n    \"\"\"Every class name theme `name`'s stylesheet has a rule for.\"\"\"\n    css = re.sub(r\"/\\*.*?\\*/\", \"\", _theme_file(name).decode(\"utf-8\"), flags=re.DOTALL)\n    return set(re.findall(r\"\\.([A-Za-z_][\\w-]*)\", css))\n\n\ndef test_step1_each_theme_styles_every_class_the_other_does():\n    # The whole admin console follows the theme too, so a class one theme\n    # forgets is an unstyled screen.\n    assert {\"admin-nav\", \"post-card\", \"theme-option\"} <= _classes(\"default\")\n    assert _classes(\"chapter\") == _classes(\"default\")\n","originalFile":"\"\"\"MP2plus F8: Switchable theme (issue #23). Each test is named after the\nacceptance step it checks:\n\n  1. Two themes exist, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/\n  2. The admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice survives a\n     server restart\n  3. `uv run cms publish` writes the selected theme's CSS as site/style.css,\n     so every page's relative stylesheet link still works\n  4. Switching back and publishing again restores the first theme's CSS\n  5. Both themes show no horizontal overflow at 390 px on the home page and\n     one post\n  6. The Settings form carries a CSRF token; its POST replayed without the\n     token is refused\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import cli, settings\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf, log_in\nfrom tests.test_phone_width import assert_fits_phone\nfrom tests.test_phone_width import awkward_content  # noqa: F401 (a fixture)\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nTHEMES_DIR = ROOT / \"app\" / \"themes\"\n\n\ndef _theme_file(name: str) -> bytes:\n    return (THEMES_DIR / name / \"style.css\").read_bytes()\n\n\ndef _theme_options(html: str) -> dict[str, bool]:\n    \"\"\"The Settings page's theme choices: each radio's value, and whether\n    it is the checked one.\"\"\"\n    radios = re.findall(r'<input [^>]*name=\"theme\"[^>]*>', html)\n    return {re.search(r'value=\"([^\"]*)\"', radio).group(1): \" checked\" in radio\n            for radio in radios}\n\n\ndef _choose_theme(admin, name: str):\n    \"\"\"Pick a theme on the Settings page, as an Admin would.\"\"\"\n    token = extract_csrf(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text)\n    return admin.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": name, \"csrf_token\": token},\n                      follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n# -- Step 1: two themes, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/ --\n\ndef test_step1_two_themes_each_one_css_file_in_its_own_folder():\n    folders = sorted(path for path in THEMES_DIR.iterdir() if path.is_dir())\n\n    assert [folder.name for folder in folders] == [\"chapter\", \"default\"]\n    for folder in folders:\n        assert [file.name for file in folder.iterdir()] == [\"style.css\"], folder\n\n\n# -- Step 2: the admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice\n#    survives a server restart --\n\ndef test_step2_an_admin_picks_the_theme_on_the_settings_page(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert _theme_options(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text) == {\n        \"default\": True, \"chapter\": False}\n\n    saved = _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    assert saved.status_code == 303\n    page = admin.get(saved.headers[\"location\"]).text\n    assert \"Theme saved\" in page\n    assert _theme_options(page) == {\"default\": False, \"chapter\": True}\n\n\ndef test_step2_the_console_and_the_preview_load_the_chosen_theme(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert admin.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n\n    _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    response = admin.get(\"/style.css\")\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/css\")\n    assert response.content == _theme_file(\"chapter\")\n\n\n# A server started afresh: a new Python process on the same database, so\n# nothing held in the first process's memory can carry the choice over.\nRESTARTED_SERVER = \"\"\"\nimport sys\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\nfrom app.main import create_app\nsys.stdout.buffer.write(TestClient(create_app()).get(\"/style.css\").content)\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef test_step2_the_choice_survives_a_server_restart(client_as):\n    _choose_theme(client_as(\"admin\"), \"chapter\")\n\n    restarted = subprocess.run(\n        [sys.executable, \"-c\", RESTARTED_SERVER], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True,\n        env={**os.environ, \"CMS_DATABASE\": str(settings.DATABASE_PATH)}, timeout=60,\n    )\n\n    assert restarted.returncode == 0, restarted.stderr.decode(errors=\"replace\")\n    assert restarted.stdout == _theme_file(\"chapter\")\n\n\ndef test_step2_an_editor_can_neither_open_nor_post_the_settings_page(client_as, client):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    token = extract_csrf(editor.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n    assert editor.get(\"/admin/settings\").status_code == 403\n    refused = editor.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": \"chapter\", \"csrf_token\": token})\n    assert refused.status_code == 403\n    assert \"Only an Admin\" in refused.text\n    assert client.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n\n\ndef test_step2_an_anonymous_visitor_is_sent_to_log_in(client):\n    for response in (client.get(\"/admin/settings\", follow_redirects=False),\n                     client.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": \"chapter\"},\n                                 follow_redirects=False)):\n        assert response.status_code == 303\n        assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\n    assert client.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n\n\ndef test_step2_only_admins_see_settings_in_the_nav(client_as):\n    assert 'href=\"admin/settings\"' in Each test is named after the\nacceptance step it checks:\n\n  1. Two themes exist, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/\n  2. The admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice survives a\n     server restart\n  3. `uv run cms publish` writes the selected theme's CSS as site/style.css,\n     so every page's relative stylesheet link still works\n  4. Switching back and publishing again restores the first theme's CSS\n  5. Both themes show no horizontal overflow at 390 px on the home page and\n     one post\n  6. The Settings form carries a CSRF token; its POST replayed without the\n     token is refused\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import cli, settings\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf, log_in\nfrom tests.test_phone_width import assert_fits_phone\nfrom tests.test_phone_width import awkward_content  # noqa: F401 (a fixture)\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nTHEMES_DIR = ROOT / \"app\" / \"themes\"\n\n\ndef _theme_file(name: str) -> bytes:\n    return (THEMES_DIR / name / \"style.css\").read_bytes()\n\n\ndef _theme_options(html: str) -> dict[str, bool]:\n    \"\"\"The Settings page's theme choices: each radio's value, and whether\n    it is the checked one.\"\"\"\n    radios = re.findall(r'<input [^>]*name=\"theme\"[^>]*>', html)\n    return {re.search(r'value=\"([^\"]*)\"', radio).group(1): \" checked\" in radio\n            for radio in radios}\n\n\ndef _choose_theme(admin, name: str):\n    \"\"\"Pick a theme on the Settings page, as an Admin would.\"\"\"\n    token = extract_csrf(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text)\n    return admin.post(\"/admin/settings\", data={\"theme\": name, \"csrf_token\": token},\n                      follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n# Each theme's light --bg, so a browser test can tell which stylesheet loaded.\nPAGE_BACKGROUND = {\"default\": \"rgb(245, 246, 250)\", \"chapter\": \"rgb(248, 246, 240)\"}\n\n\ndef _body_background(page) -> str:\n    return page.evaluate(\"getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor\")\n\n\n# -- Step 1: two themes, each one CSS file in its own folder under app/themes/ --\n\ndef test_step1_two_themes_each_one_css_file_in_its_own_folder():\n    folders = sorted(path for path in THEMES_DIR.iterdir() if path.is_dir())\n\n    assert [folder.name for folder in folders] == [\"chapter\", \"default\"]\n    for folder in folders:\n        assert [file.name for file in folder.iterdir()] == [\"style.css\"], folder\n\n\ndef _classes(name: str) -> set[str]:\n    \"\"\"Every class name theme `name`'s stylesheet has a rule for.\"\"\"\n    css = re.sub(r\"/\\*.*?\\*/\", \"\", _theme_file(name).decode(\"utf-8\"), flags=re.DOTALL)\n    return set(re.findall(r\"\\.([A-Za-z_][\\w-]*)\", css))\n\n\ndef test_step1_each_theme_styles_every_class_the_other_does():\n    # The whole admin console follows the theme too, so a class one theme\n    # forgets is an unstyled screen.\n    assert {\"admin-nav\", \"post-card\", \"theme-option\"} <= _classes(\"default\")\n    assert _classes(\"chapter\") == _classes(\"default\")\n\n\n# -- Step 2: the admin Settings page selects the theme, and the choice\n#    survives a server restart --\n\ndef test_step2_an_admin_picks_the_theme_on_the_settings_page(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert _theme_options(admin.get(\"/admin/settings\").text) == {\n        \"default\": True, \"chapter\": False}\n\n    saved = _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    assert saved.status_code == 303\n    page = admin.get(saved.headers[\"location\"]).text\n    assert \"Theme saved\" in page\n    assert _theme_options(page) == {\"default\": False, \"chapter\": True}\n\n\ndef test_step2_the_console_and_the_preview_load_the_chosen_theme(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert admin.get(\"/style.css\").content == _theme_file(\"default\")\n\n    _choose_theme(admin, \"chapter\")\n\n    response = admin.get(\"/style.css\")\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/css\")\n    assert response.content == It never changes content or links. The CMS has two, `default` (indigo on cool grey) and `chapter` (black and gold), with `default` used until an Admin picks another. The dev server serves the selected Theme as `style.css` from the next page load; `cms publish` copies it byte for byte into the Static export as `site/style.css`, the file every page already links.\n_Avoid_: skin, template (a template is a page's HTML)\n\n**Settings page**:\nThe admin-only screen at `/admin/settings` where an Admin picks the Theme. What it saves is a row in the database's `settings` table, so it survives a restart. {"parentUuid":"fc20a2f5-1345-43f9-931d-6b8850bf9238","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"7c93a0cb-6af1-4200-add8-f3f8ea098e20","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_016c42ETRvwZgjRWQ5GtT3Sm","type":"tool_result","content":"The file C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\CONTEXT.md has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"b9a0ba02-9de3-478b-b643-06e905a0b1dc","timestamp":"2026-10-21T06:30:06.440Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\CONTEXT.md","oldString":"_Avoid_: summary, snippet (a Snippet is the Media library's Markdown)","newString":"_Avoid_: summary, snippet (a Snippet is the Media library's Markdown)\n\n## Look\n\n**Theme**:\nOne complete stylesheet, `app/themes/<name>/style.css`, that sets how both the admin console and the public site look: colours, type, corners. It never changes content or links. The CMS has two, `default` (indigo on cool grey) and `chapter` (black and gold), with `default` used until an Admin picks another. The dev server serves the selected Theme as `style.css` from the next page load; `cms publish` copies it byte for byte into the Static export as `site/style.css`, the file every page already links.\n_Avoid_: skin, template (a template is a page's HTML)\n\n**Settings page**:\nThe admin-only screen at `/admin/settings` where an Admin picks the Theme. What it saves is a row in the database's `settings` table, so it survives a restart. Unlike the configuration in `.env` (`app/settings.py`), it changes while the CMS runs.\n_Avoid_: preferences, config (config is `.env`)","originalFile":"# CONTEXT.md glossary\n\nA small, WordPress-style web CMS: a local admin console where Editors and Admins manage content, and a static public site that publishes it. The content model is intentionally generic — built with no specific client in mind. A specific client site has been built *using* this CMS. The site was created for the Upper Arlington High School's Computer Science Honor Society chapter (UAHS CSHS), specifically for Dr. Diane Kahle (faculty advisor). The chapter needs a website to promote computer science among UAHS students.\n\n## Roles\n\n**Admin**:\nA CMS user role with full permissions: everything an Editor can do, plus publishing/unpublishing content and managing user accounts (create, change role, deactivate). When this CMS is introduced to the client for the UAHS CSHS chapter, Dr. Kahle will be given admin permissions.\n_Avoid_: superadmin, owner\n\n**Editor**:\nA CMS user role that can create, edit, and delete any Post or Page — including another user's drafts — but cannot publish/unpublish content or manage user accounts. Student officers will be given Editor permissions.\n_Avoid_: contributor, author (an Author is a content attribute, not a role)\n\n## Content\n\n**Post**:\nA dated, feed-like content item with a title, slug, Markdown body, draft/published status, author, and timestamps. Appears in the site's chronological feed.\n_Avoid_: article, entry\n\n**Page**:\nA static, evergreen content item — same fields and operations as a Post, plus appearing in the public site's navigation once published. The UAHS-CSHS website includes The Latest Posts, Coursework, Contact Us, About Us (mission + why join + eligibility + requirements + questions).\n_Avoid_: static page (redundant)\n\n**Slug**:\nThe URL-safe identifier for a Post or Page, unique within its kind, used to build its published path. \n\n**Status (Draft / Published)**:\nThe two states a Post or Page can be in. A Draft is visible only in the admin console; only a Published item reaches the static export.\n_Avoid_: live/unlive, active/inactive\n\n**Author**:\nThe user (Admin or Editor) recorded as having written a given Post or Page. Distinct from whoever most recently edited it.\n\n## Publishing\n\n**Publish** (verb):\nThe admin-only action that flips a content item's status from Draft to Published, making it eligible to appear in the next static export.\n_Avoid_: approve (there's no separate approval workflow — publish is a single, direct action)\n\n**Static export**:\nThe `site/` directory `cms publish` generates from currently-published content only; what `cms deploy` pushes to GitHub Pages. Every link in it is relative. A link written in a body from the site root (`/contact-us.html`) is rewritten relative to the file it lands in (`./contact-us.html`, or `../contact-us.html` from a Post), since GitHub Pages serves the site from a subfolder. The admin preview keeps it as written.\n\n**Revision**:\nOne saved version of a Post or Page: its title, slug, and body, who saved it, and when, numbered 1, 2, 3… within that item. Every create, edit, and Roll back records one; Publish and unpublish do not, since they change Status, not content.\n_Avoid_: snapshot, history entry\n\n**Revision history**:\nThe list of an item's Revisions, newest first, on its edit screen. The newest is the Current one.\n\n**Roll back** (verb):\nReturning an item's title, slug, and body to those of an earlier Revision. Editors and Admins can do it; it is itself recorded as a new Revision, so a Roll back can be undone the same way. Status is unchanged: a Published item's restored text reaches the site on the next static export.\n_Avoid_: restore, revert, undo\n\n**Scheduled publishing**:\nAn Admin setting a future time, in UTC, after which a Draft becomes Published. The public site is static, so nothing happens at that moment: the item becomes Published on the next `cms publish` after its time, which switches it before writing the static export. Setting or cancelling a schedule records no Revision, since it changes Status, not content.\n_Avoid_: auto-publish, publishing \"automatically\"\n\n**Scheduled**:\nA Draft with a publish time set. The dashboard and lists show it as \"scheduled\", apart from other Drafts. Publishing or unpublishing it by hand cancels its schedule.\n\n## Media\n\n**Media library**:\nThe admin screen where Editors and Admins upload images for Posts (PNG or JPEG, 2 MB or less) and copy each one's Snippet. The files live in `media/`, which is git-ignored like the database; `cms publish` copies all of `media/` into the Static export.\n_Avoid_: gallery, uploads\n\n**Alt text**:\nThe words that describe an image to someone who can't see it; a screen reader reads them aloud. Every upload needs it, and the Snippet carries it into the Post's `<img alt>`.\n_Avoid_: caption (a caption is shown to everyone)\n\n**Snippet**:\nThe Markdown the Media library shows for each image, `![<Alt text>](media/<file>)`, ready to paste into a Post's body. `media/` is read from the site root, so the Static export rewrites it relative to the file it lands in (`../media/<file>` from a Post), and the editor's preview does the same for its own page.\n\n## Search\n\n**Search index**:\nThe file `search-index.json` that `cms publish` writes into the Static export: the title, relative URL, and Excerpt of every Published Post and Page, and nothing from a Draft. The public site's search page (`search.html`) reads it in the reader's browser and lists every item whose title or Excerpt holds each typed word. There is no search server.\n_Avoid_: search database\n\n**Excerpt**:\nThe start of a Post's or Page's body as plain text, 160 characters or fewer, cut at a word and ended with \"…\" when there is more. Search results show it under the title.\n_Avoid_: summary, snippet (a Snippet is the Media library's Markdown)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":81,"oldLines":3,"newStart":81,"newLines":13,"lines":[" **Excerpt**:"," The start of a Post's or Page's body as plain text, 160 characters or fewer, cut at a word and ended with \"…\" when there is more. It never changes content or links. The CMS has two, `default` (indigo on cool grey) and `chapter` (black and gold), with `default` used until an Admin picks another. The dev server serves the selected Theme as `style.css` from the next page load; `cms publish` copies it byte for byte into the Static export as `site/style.css`, the file every page already links.","+_Avoid_: skin, template (a template is a page's HTML)","+","+**Settings page**:","+The admin-only screen at `/admin/settings` where an Admin picks the Theme. Both\nrender through app.publish and app.theme, so the local preview and the\ndeployed site can't drift.","originalFile":"\"\"\"The public site, served live by the dev server at the same paths the static\nexport writes (index.html, posts/<slug>.html, <slug>.html, and search.html with\nits search.js and search-index.json). Both render through app.publish, so the\nlocal preview and the deployed site can't drift.\nOnly published content is ever served; a draft's URL is a 404.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, Response\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import theme as theme_module\nfrom app.publish import (\n    SEARCH_JS, home_html, page_html, post_html, search_html, search_index_json,\n)\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n@router.get(\"/index.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef home():\n    return home_html()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/style.css\")\ndef style_css():\n    # The selected Theme, read per request: a switch on the Settings page\n    # shows on the next page load. The admin console links this file too.\n    return Response(theme_module.stylesheet().read_bytes(), media_type=\"text/css\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/search.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef search_page():\n    return search_html()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/search.js\")\ndef search_js():\n    return Response(SEARCH_JS, media_type=\"text/javascript\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/search-index.json\")\ndef search_index():\n    return Response(search_index_json(), media_type=\"application/json\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/posts/{slug}.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef public_post(slug: str):\n    post = content_module.get_published_by_slug(\"post\", slug)\n    if post is None:\n        raise HTTPException(404)\n    return post_html(post)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{slug}.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef public_page(slug: str):\n    page = content_module.get_published_by_slug(\"page\", slug)\n    if page is None:\n        raise HTTPException(404)\n    return page_html(page)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":7,"newStart":1,"newLines":8,"lines":[" \"\"\"The public site, served live by the dev server at the same paths the static","-export writes (index.html, posts/<slug>.html, <slug>.html, and search.html with","-its search.js and search-index.json). It never changes content or links. The CMS has two, `default` (indigo on cool grey) and `chapter` (black and gold), with `default` used until an Admin picks another. The dev server serves the selected Theme as `style.css` from the next page load; `cms publish` copies it byte for byte into the Static export as `site/style.css`, the file every page already links.\n_Avoid_: skin, template (a template is a page's HTML)\n\n**Settings page**:\nThe admin-only screen at `/admin/settings` where an Admin picks the Theme. What it saves is a row in the database's `settings` table, so it survives a restart. Unlike the configuration in `.env` (`app/settings.py`), it changes while the CMS runs.\n_Avoid_: preferences, config (config is `.env`)"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_017g4CKtJ2KZkssB7Bei2WtA","name":"Edit","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\.env.example","old_string":"# Set after you deploy, e.g. https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\nCMS_BASE_PATH=","new_string":"# Set after you deploy, e.g. https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\nCMS_BASE_PATH=\n# No variable for the Theme (default or chapter): an Admin picks it on the\n# Settings page, /admin/settings, and the database keeps the choice."},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_019N7ogR9qUGp3MRCHa2rsui","name":"Edit","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\routes\\public.py","old_string":"\"\"\"The public site, served live by the dev server at the same paths the static\nexport writes (index.html, posts/<slug>.html, <slug>.html, and search.html with\nits search.js and search-index.json). Bring a laptop & \"\n    \"[read the rules](/about.html) first.\\n\\n\" + \"We will build line-following robots. \" * 12)\nadd(\"post\", \"Hour of Code volunteers needed\", \"hour-of-code\",\n    \"Help us teach younger students to code during <em>Computer Science</em> Education Week.\")\nadd(\"post\", \"Secret officer elections draft\", \"officer-elections\",\n    \"Not ready yet: robotics budget talk.\", published=False)\nadd(\"page\", \"Secret coursework draft\", \"coursework\", \"Draft page body.\", published=False)\n\nresults = []\n\n\ndef check(name, ok, detail=\"\"):\n    results.append((name, bool(ok)))\n    print((\"PASS \" if ok else \"FAIL \") + name + (f\"  ({detail})\" if detail and not ok else \"\"))\n\n\ndef free_port():\n    s = socket.socket()\n    s.bind((\"127.0.0.1\", 0))\n    port = s.getsockname()[1]\n    s.close()\n    return port\n\n\ndef overflow(page):\n    return page.evaluate(\"document.documentElement.scrollWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth\")\n\n\n# -- Steps 1-3 and 5: publish with drafts present, read site/ --\ncheck(\"cms publish exits 0\", cli.main([\"publish\"]) == 0)\nsite = settings.SITE\nindex = json.loads((site / \"search-index.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\nprint(json.dumps(index, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))\ntitles = [entry[\"title\"] for entry in index]\ncheck(\"1 index has every published post and page\",\n      sorted(titles) == sorted([\"Welcome\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"Hour of Code volunteers needed\", \"About\"]), titles)\ncheck(\"1 each entry has title, url, excerpt\", all(set(e) == {\"title\", \"url\", \"excerpt\"} for e in index))\ncheck(\"1 urls are relative and exist\",\n      all(not e[\"url\"].startswith(\"/\") and \":\" not in e[\"url\"] and (site / e[\"url\"]).is_file() for e in index))\ncheck(\"1 excerpts are short plain text\", all(len(e[\"excerpt\"]) <= 161 and \"<\" not in e[\"excerpt\"] for e in index))\nraw_index = (site / \"search-index.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\ncheck(\"2 drafts absent\", \"Secret\" not in raw_index and \"Upcoming\" not in raw_index and \"Not ready\" not in raw_index)\nsearch_page = (site / \"search.html\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\nscripts = re.findall(r\"<script\\b([^>]*)>(.*?)</script>\", search_page, re.S)\ncheck(\"3 one script tag, external file, relative src\",\n      len(scripts) == 1 and scripts[0][1].strip() == \"\" and 'src=\"search.js\"' in scripts[0][0], scripts)\njs = (site / \"search.js\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\ncheck(\"3 search.js is 60 lines or fewer\", len(js.splitlines()) <= 60, len(js.splitlines()))\ncheck(\"3 no external URL in search.js\", \"://\" not in js and \"import\" not in js)\ncheck(\"3 no root-absolute href/src in search.html\", 'href=\"/' not in search_page and 'src=\"/' not in search_page)\nhome = (site / \"index.html\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\ncheck(\"5 home links to search.html relatively\", 'href=\"search.html\"' in home)\nall_html = \"\\n\".join(p.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\") for p in site.rglob(\"*.html\"))\ncheck(\"no root-absolute href/src anywhere in site/\", 'href=\"/' not in all_html and 'src=\"/' not in all_html)\n\n# -- Step 4: preview with python -m http.server, as the judge does --\nSCREENSHOTS = REPO / \"docs\" / \"screenshots\"\nsite_port = free_port()\nhttp = kwargs={\"sockets\": [sock]}, daemon=True).start()\nwhile not server.started:\n    time.sleep(0.05)\n\n\ndef walk(browser, base, width, label, shot=None):\n    context = {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"0008ac86-4a00-4c89-8a62-5971452a5ff3","hash":"3050d25f743bf78e8cb19a7440d407287f631a4d03c4a1bbece148b147081b89","message":{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"","signature":""},{"type":"thinking","thinking":"Using the F5 walk script as a base, I'm building a theme walk that starts/restarts the dev server, byte-compares `site/style.css`, checks both themes at 1280px and 390px, and replays the Settings POST without its token—all against a scratch database.\n\n","signature":""},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01EsRWDmUDGfTC3tGdV7Mo71","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\rajan\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\claude\\C--Rajan-E-disk-My-work-IPHS400-code-mp2-cms\\0008ac86-4a00-4c89-8a62-5971452a5ff3\\scratchpad\\walk_theme.py","content":"\"\"\"Judge-style walk of issue #23 (switchable theme) over real HTTP, isolated\nfrom the real cms.db and site/. The dev server runs as its own process, so\n\"restart the server\" is a real restart.\nUsage: uv run python walk_theme.py <repo> <workdir> [--shots]\n\"\"\"\nimport os\nimport re\nimport shutil\nimport socket\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nimport time\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nREPO, WORK = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2])\nSHOTS = \"--shots\" in sys.argv\nsys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))\n\nfrom app import settings  # noqa: E402\n\nif WORK.exists():\n    shutil.rmtree(WORK)\nWORK.mkdir(parents=True)\nsettings.DATABASE_PATH = WORK / \"cms.db\"\nsettings.MEDIA = WORK / \"media\"\nsettings.SITE = WORK / \"site\"\n\nfrom playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright  # noqa: E402\n\nfrom app import cli  # noqa: E402\nfrom app import content as content_module  # noqa: E402\nfrom app import db as db_module  # noqa: E402\nfrom app.seed import seed_pages, seed_posts, seed_users  # noqa: E402\n\nADMIN_PW, EDITOR_PW = \"walk-admin-pw\", \"walk-editor-pw\"\nseed_users(settings.DATABASE_PATH, ADMIN_PW, EDITOR_PW)\nseed_posts(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\nseed_pages(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\nconn = db_module.connect()\nADMIN = conn.execute(\"SELECT id FROM users WHERE role = 'admin'\").fetchone()[\"id\"]\nADMIN_EMAIL = conn.execute(\"SELECT email FROM users WHERE role = 'admin'\").fetchone()[\"email\"]\nEDITOR_EMAIL = conn.execute(\"SELECT email FROM users WHERE role = 'editor'\").fetchone()[\"email\"]\nconn.close()\n\n\ndef add(kind, title, slug, body):\n    content_id = content_module.create_content(kind, title, slug, body, ADMIN)\n    content_module.set_status(content_id, kind, \"published\")\n\n\nadd(\"post\", \"Hour of Code volunteers needed\", \"hour-of-code\",\n    \"Help us teach younger students to code during **Computer Science** Education Week. \"\n    \"Sign up on the [Contact Us](/contact-us.html) page.\\n\\n\"\n    \"> Every volunteer gets service hours.\\n\\n```\\nprint('Hello, Golden Bears')\\n```\\n\")\nadd(\"post\", \"Robotics club kickoff\", \"robotics-kickoff\",\n    \"Our first robotics meeting is Thursday in room 204. \" * 8)\nadd(\"page\", \"Contact Us\", \"contact-us\", \"Email the officers at cshs@example.org.\")\n\nTHEMES = REPO / \"app\" / \"themes\"\nBACKGROUND = {\"default\": \"rgb(245, 246, 250)\", \"chapter\": \"rgb(248, 246, 240)\"}\nresults = []\n\n\ndef check(name, ok, detail=\"\"):\n    results.append((name, bool(ok)))\n    print((\"PASS \" if ok else \"FAIL \") + name + (f\"  ({detail})\" if detail and not ok else \"\"))\n\n\ndef free_port():\n    s = socket.socket()\n    s.bind((\"127.0.0.1\", 0))\n    port = s.getsockname()[1]\n    s.close()\n    return port\n\n\ndef wait_for_port(port, proc):\n    deadline = time.monotonic() + 20\n    while time.monotonic() < deadline:\n        assert proc.poll() is None, \"server exited\"\n        try:\n            socket.create_connection((\"127.0.0.1\", port), timeout=0.2).close()\n            return\n        except OSError:\n            time.sleep(0.1)\n    raise RuntimeError(\"server did not start\")\n\n\ndef start_server():\n    port = free_port()\n    env = {**os.environ, \"CMS_DATABASE\": str(settings.DATABASE_PATH), \"PYTHONPATH\": \"\"}\n    proc = subprocess.Popen(\n        [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"uvicorn\", \"app.main:app\", \"--port\", str(port),\n         \"--log-level\", \"warning\"], cwd=REPO, env=env)\n    wait_for_port(port, proc)\n    return proc, f\"http://127.0.0.1:{port}\"\n\n\ndef stop_server(proc):\n    proc.terminate()\n    proc.wait(timeout=10)\n\n\ndef overflow(page):\n    return page.evaluate(\"document.documentElement.scrollWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth\")\n\n\ndef background(page):\n    return page.evaluate(\"getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor\")\n\n\ndef log_in(page, base, email, password):\n    page.goto(base + \"/login\")\n    page.fill(\"input[name=email]\", email)\n    page.fill(\"input[name=password]\", password)\n    page.click(\"button[type=submit]\")\n    page.wait_for_url(\"**/admin\")\n\n\ndef choose(page, base, name, label):\n    page.goto(base + \"/admin\")\n    page.click(\"nav.admin-nav a:has-text('Settings')\")\n    page.wait_for_url(\"**/admin/settings\")\n    page.check(f\"input[name=theme][value={name}]\")\n    page.click(\"form.settings-form button[type=submit]\")\n    page.wait_for_url(\"**/admin/settings?saved=theme\")\n    check(f\"{label} saved message\", \"Theme saved\" in page.inner_text(\".success\"))\n    check(f\"{label} {name} is checked\", page.is_checked(f\"input[name=theme][value={name}]\"))\n    check(f\"{label} the console now uses {name}\", background(page) == BACKGROUND[name], background(page))\n\n\ndef publish_and_compare(name, label):\n    check(f\"{label} cms publish exits 0\", cli.main([\"publish\"]) == 0)\n    written = (settings.SITE / \"style.css\").read_bytes()\n    check(f\"{label} site/style.css == app/themes/{name}/style.css\",\n          written == (THEMES / name / \"style.css\").read_bytes())\n    for html in settings.SITE.rglob(\"*.html\"):\n        href = re.search(r'<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"([^\"]+)\">', html.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")).group(1)\n        ok = not href.startswith(\"/\") and (html.parent / href).resolve() == (settings.SITE / \"style.css\").resolve()\n        check(f\"{label} {html.relative_to(settings.SITE).as_posix()} links {href}\", ok)\n\n\ndef walk_site(browser, name, label, shots=False):\n    site_port = free_port()\n    http = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, \"-m\", \"http.server\", \"-d\", str(settings.SITE), str(site_port)],\n                            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)\n    try:\n        wait_for_port(site_port, http)\n        base = f\"http://127.0.0.1:{site_port}\"\n        for width in (1280, 390):\n            context = browser.new_context(viewport={\"width\": width, \"height\": 900 if width > 400 else 844})\n            page = context.new_page()\n            failed = []\n            page.on(\"response\", lambda r: failed.append(r.url) if r.status >= 400 else None)\n            for path in (\"/index.html\", \"/posts/hour-of-code.html\", \"/contact-us.html\"):\n                page.goto(base + path)\n                check(f\"{label}@{width} {path} in {name}\", background(page) == BACKGROUND[name], background(page))\n                check(f\"{label}@{width} {path} fits\", overflow(page) <= 0, overflow(page))\n            if shots:\n                page.goto(base + \"/index.html\")\n                page.screenshot(path=str(REPO / \"docs\" / \"screenshots\" / f\"mp2plus-theme-{width}.png\"),\n                                full_page=True)\n            check(f\"{label}@{width} no 4xx responses\", not failed, failed)\n            context.close()\n    finally:\n        http.terminate()\n\n\ndef admin_pages_fit(browser, base, name):\n    context = browser.new_context(viewport={\"width\": 390, \"height\": 844})\n    page = context.new_page()\n    log_in(page, base, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PW)\n    post_id = re.search(r\"admin/posts/(\\d+)/edit\", (page.goto(base + \"/admin/posts\") and page.content())).group(1)\n    for path in (\"/admin\", \"/admin/content\", \"/admin/posts\", f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/edit\",\n                 \"/admin/pages\", \"/admin/media\", \"/admin/users\", \"/admin/users/new\", \"/admin/settings\"):\n        page.goto(base + path)\n        check(f\"admin@390 {path} in {name} fits\", overflow(page) <= 0 and background(page) == BACKGROUND[name],\n              f\"{overflow(page)} {background(page)}\")\n    context.close()\n\n\nserver, base = start_server()\ntry:\n    with sync_playwright() as pw:\n        browser = pw.chromium.launch()\n        admin_ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={\"width\": 1280, \"height\": 900})\n        admin = admin_ctx.new_page()\n        errors = []\n        admin.on(\"pageerror\", lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))\n        log_in(admin, base, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PW)\n        check(\"settings page starts on default\", admin.goto(base + \"/admin/settings\") and\n              admin.is_checked(\"input[name=theme][value=default]\"))\n        check(\"both themes are listed with descriptions\",\n              admin.locator(\".theme-option\").count() == 2 and\n              \"Black and gold\" in admin.inner_text(\".settings-form\"))\n\n        # -- Step 2: switch, then restart the server --\n        choose(admin, base, \"chapter\", \"2 switch\")\n        stop_server(server)\n        server, base = start_server()\n        check(\"2 after restart /style.css is chapter\",\n              admin.request.get(base + \"/style.css\").body() == (THEMES / \"chapter\" / \"style.css\").read_bytes())\n        restarted = browser.new_context(viewport={\"width\": 1280, \"height\": 900}).new_page()\n        log_in(restarted, base, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PW)\n        restarted.goto(base + \"/admin/settings\")\n        check(\"2 after restart chapter is still checked\", restarted.is_checked(\"input[name=theme][value=chapter]\"))\n\n        # -- Steps 3 and 5: publish, compare, both widths --\n        publish_and_compare(\"chapter\", \"3\")\n        walk_site(browser, \"chapter\", \"5 site\", shots=SHOTS)\n        admin_pages_fit(browser, base, \"chapter\")\n\n        # -- Step 4: switch back, publish again --\n        choose(restarted, base, \"default\", \"4 switch back\")\n        publish_and_compare(\"default\", \"4\")\n        walk_site(browser, \"default\", \"5 site\")\n        admin_pages_fit(browser, base, \"default\")\n\n        # -- Step 6: replay the Settings POST without its token --\n        admin.goto(base + \"/admin/settings\")\n        for label, form in ((\"absent\", {\"theme\": \"chapter\"}),\n                            (\"forged\", {\"theme\": \"chapter\", \"csrf_token\": \"forged\"})):\n            replay = admin.request.post(base + \"/admin/settings\", form=form, max_redirects=0)\n            check(f\"6 replay with token {label} is 403\", replay.status == 403, replay.status)\n        check(\"6 the theme did not change\", admin.request.get(base + \"/style.css\").body()\n              == (THEMES / \"default\" / \"style.css\").read_bytes())\n        token = re.search(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"', admin.content()).group(1)\n        good = admin.request.post(base + \"/admin/settings\", form={\"theme\": \"default\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n                                  max_redirects=0)\n        check(\"6 the same POST with its token is accepted\", good.status == 303, good.status)\n\n        # -- Roles: the Settings page is admin only --\n        editor = browser.new_context(viewport={\"width\": 1280, \"height\": 900}).new_page()\n        log_in(editor, base, EDITOR_EMAIL, EDITOR_PW)\n        check(\"editor nav has no Settings\", editor.locator(\"nav.admin-nav a:has-text('Settings')\").count() == 0)\n        response = editor.goto(base + \"/admin/settings\")\n        check(\"editor GET /admin/settings is 403\", response.status == 403, response.status)\n        check(\"editor sees Access denied\", \"Only an Admin\" in editor.content())\n        anon = browser.new_context().new_page()\n        anon.goto(base + \"/admin/settings\")\n        check(\"anonymous is sent to /login\", anon.url.endswith(\"/login\"), anon.url)\n        check(\"no page errors\", not errors, errors)\n        browser.close()\nfinally:\n    stop_server(server)\n\nfailed = [name for name, ok in results if not ok]\nprint(f\"\\n{len(results) - len(failed)}/{len(results)} passed\" + (f\"; FAILED: {failed}\" if failed else \"\"))\nsys.exit(1 if failed else 0)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}
